jobs.title: Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India
jobs.description:
About the TeamMore than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.About the RoleThis PM and Market Leader of India will oversee the newly announced pillar for WhatsApp, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp pillar, from the very first day. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.As a Product Leader at WhatsApp, you will use your experience building products from early concept through launch in fast-moving environments and your full range of product development skills to produce intuitive, user-friendly features. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. This is a role for someone who can hold both the ceiling and the floor: sets an ambitious long-term vision for what WhatsApp can become in India.
  
  
Director, Product Management - WhatsApp India Responsibilities:
  
  

* Drive product strategy and development for one of the highest-priority initiatives across WhatsApp and Meta
* Establish a shared vision across the company (WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Messenger) and ensure that all teams are clear on the overall strategy, the problem to be solved, timeline, and required contributions
* Ability to move fast to drive alignment and execution – Turn high volumes of different actions into repeatable processes and playbooks, and get alignment within and across teams through both influence and framing clear escalations when team priorities conflict
* Manage multiple products and priorities, scale teams, and ensure org is effective, healthy and set up for success by establishing clear and measurable goals – Collaborate, navigate and influence product teams across WhatsApp
* Consumer, Business, Privacy, Growth and Messaging Services, and the broader Meta organization (including Instagram and Facebook)
* Drive executional excellence and analytical rigor across teams – Drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions to reduce operational overhead, streamline decision-making and accelerate overall execution
* Manage business reviews (i.e., weekly/monthly business reviews, functional reviews, and other key meetings), staff meetings, and all hands meetings
* Lead reviews of dashboards and reports for stakeholders and team members to drive transparency and track improvements
* Proactively identify issues and needs, escalate as needed, and devise processes to resolve them
* Coordinate working groups for areas of ownership that we need to establish, but which cut across organizational lines
* At times, you may be specifically tasked to own a workstream, or to dive deep into different parts of the organization
* Lead org-wide projects to create business value, aligning multiple stakeholders across Meta, including various product teams, go-to-market, Finance, Operations, Research, and Family of Apps

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 15+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years leading PM teams (managing managers)
* Strong technical judgment and ability to partner with ML/ranking teams on signal quality, bidding systems, and delivery optimization
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of bets at different maturity stages — from 0-to-1 incubation to billion-dollar scaled products — simultaneously
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership: ability to drive alignment across engineering, data science, design, sales, partnerships, and policy
* Experience applying analytical rigor and data-driven decision-making, including defining and optimizing product metrics and data-driven decision-making, with experience in defining and optimizing metrics

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* B.A. or B.S. in Computer Science or a related field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business)
* Experience in building and scaling early-stage growth efforts
* Proficiency in using AI tools as part of day-to-day product development and general productivity workflow
* Track record of successfully executing the strategy in the APAC region
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
  
  
We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto-funded card, or a fiat-to-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
**We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products.**
We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!
  
  
As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options.
  
  
We’re a world-class, well-funded, diverse team from over 20 different countries that believes in the product we’re building and the service we’re providing for our members. We’ve grown significantly in the last 18 months and are evolving our Marketing structure to reflect that.
  
  
**We are offering a salary of up to 2,500,000 INR for this role, plus a company cash bonus scheme and benefits**
**About The Role**
We're hiring a senior product designer who puts members first and uses AI to move faster. You'll understand our members deeply, design journeys that genuinely help them, and use Claude Design to turn ideas into tested, build-ready designs in days rather than weeks.
  
  
You'll be based in India and work closely with product managers, the rest of the design team and compliance across the UK and India. Half your value is what you design and ship for members. The other half is helping the team work in an AI-first way.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the design of the member experience across their whole time with us, from sign-up to the day they leave. Work with your PM from framing the problem to a design the team can build.
* Start with members. Run regular remote research and usability tests with our UK members, listen to member calls and read feedback, and bring what you learn into every decision.
* Design for members who may be financially stretched or vulnerable, so journeys are clear, fair and easy to use. Help us deliver good outcomes under the UK's Consumer Duty.
* Design in Claude Design and produce build-ready work: clear flows, states, edge cases and specs that need few handoffs.
* Use AI to prototype and test ideas with real members quickly, and to run more experiments on our most important journeys.
* Help move the team from Figma-first to Claude Design-first, with a bias for action.
* Grow our design system, so components stay consistent and reusable.
* Raise the bar on quality: accessibility, responsive behaviour, content and the small details members notice.
* Work with compliance early so regulated copy and flows are right first time.
* Share what you learn. Pair with designers, run show and tells, and write things down.

**What you'll need to succeed**

* Five or more years in product design, with a portfolio that shows how you think and the difference your work made for customers.
* A track record of putting customers first: you've used research, data and testing to understand real needs, and changed a design because of what you learned.
* Hands-on experience designing with AI tools (ideally Claude Design), with good judgement about where AI helps and where it doesn't.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* A strong grasp of accessibility and inclusive design, built in from the start.
* Clear, kind communication. You can explain a design decision to a PM, a compliance lead and a member in the same afternoon.
* Experience working with teams in other countries and time zones

**Nice to have**

* Experience in fintech, lending or another regulated business, ideally designing for UK customers.
* Experience designing for customers in financial difficulty or other vulnerable situations.
* Running or analysing A/B tests.
* Design tokens and keeping Figma variables consistent across the system.
* Building marketing pages in Webflow or similar.

Please note that the People Team is contactable only via people@creditspring.co. Unsolicited emails to other team members will not be actioned.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer- AI
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Designer – AI**
who is passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered product experiences that simplify complex problems and create meaningful customer impact.

You will work at the intersection of Product Design, AI and emerging technologies, designing intuitive experiences that make AI capabilities accessible, useful and trustworthy for customers.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, senior leadership and other stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance customer experiences, rethink existing workflows and build innovative solutions.

We are looking for a designer who combines strong UI/UX fundamentals with curiosity about AI, understands how users interact with intelligent systems and can translate complex AI capabilities into simple, human-centric experiences.

**What You'll Do**

* Design end-to-end experiences for AI-powered products and features, from problem discovery and user journeys to high-fidelity UI and interaction design.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to solve customer problems, simplify workflows and improve product experiences.
* Design intuitive conversational interfaces, AI assistants, chat-based experiences and intelligent user interactions.
* Translate complex AI capabilities, outputs and workflows into simple, understandable and user-friendly experiences.
* Design for AI-specific interactions, including prompts, responses, recommendations, contextual suggestions, feedback loops and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Explore and prototype AI-powered product concepts rapidly, using emerging AI tools and technologies.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists to understand AI capabilities, technical constraints and opportunities for product innovation.
* Design experiences that build user trust through transparency, explainability, appropriate feedback and clear communication of AI-generated outputs.
* Anticipate AI-specific user experience challenges such as inaccurate responses, uncertainty, latency and unexpected outputs, and design appropriate user experiences around them.
* Conduct user research and usability testing to understand how customers interact with AI-powered features and continuously improve the experience.
* Contribute to Jupiter's design system and ensure consistency across AI-powered and traditional product experiences.
* Use qualitative insights and product metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of AI experiences and drive continuous improvements.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years of hands-on Product Design experience in consumer-facing technology or product-led organisations.
* Experience designing AI-powered products, intelligent interfaces, conversational experiences or AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLM-powered applications, generative AI and conversational user experiences.
* A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design capabilities, preferably including AI-driven product experiences.
* Excellent UI/UX, interaction design, prototyping and visual design skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts and translate them into intuitive customer experiences.
* Understanding of prompt-based interactions, contextual responses, AI recommendations and human-AI collaboration.
* Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business objectives and technical feasibility.
* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and experimenting with emerging technologies.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* A curious, experimental mindset and enthusiasm for exploring how AI can transform everyday customer experiences.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience designing LLM-based products, AI copilots, chatbots, trust-based plus agentic AI experiences.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and the limitations of generative AI.
* Experience designing AI experiences involving personalisation, recommendations, automation or intelligent decision-making.
* Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude code, Gemini, Lovable, Cursor or other AI-powered prototyping and design tools.
* Experience working on fintech, banking, lending or other complex consumer-facing products.

**Why You'll Love Working With Us**

* **Ownership:**
  Take responsibility for your work and drive projects from concept to impact.
* **Meaningful Problems:**
  Solve real-world financial challenges and build intelligent experiences that make managing money easier.
* **Innovation:**
  Work on emerging AI capabilities and explore new ways of building customer-centric financial products.
* **Open Culture:**
  We encourage healthy debates, diverse perspectives and open communication.
* **Speed & Trust:**
  We believe in consent over consensus, empowering teams to make decisions and move forward.
* **Continuous Learning:**
  Work with talented people who challenge you to raise the bar and grow every day.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager- Payments - Exp 4-7 years- Pune
Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding

jobs.title: Product Management - Investments Advisory - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in the Product Management team to partner with the Business.
  
  
As a Product Manager in the Product Management team, you will be responsible for the product vision and strategies to come up with innovative solutions to problems that are valuable (our users choose to use them), viable (the solution works for the business), usable (the users can figure out how to use) and feasible.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Understand client and advisor needs. Invests in a deep understanding of the business opportunity, advisor & client needs and competitive landscape. Dive into research to uncover what matters most, ensuring every feature is relevant, useful, and ahead of the curve.
* Be passionate about AI & Innovation - Bring relentless passion for AI and innovation to the Private Bank every day. Focus on delivering standout client and product experiences. Collaborate closely with developers and UX designers to create intuitive, differentiated solutions. Prioritize features that deliver client impact and business goals, within complex control requirements.
* Inspire adoption – define and track KPIs for usage & impact (both quantitative & qualitative) metrics. Focus on constantly aligning our AI powered digital solutions with user needs to maximize AI adoption and impact across the Private Bank.
* Drives the product development lifecycle - define requirements (in partnership with cross-functional teams), ensuring sprint inputs and outputs are as envisioned, and providing direction and smart trade off decisions for the scrum team. Collaborates with others across broader teams to deliver end-to-end product and experience.
* Embody true “customer-obsession”. Put customer obsession at the heart of everything—leverage user data, performance metrics, industry trends, and all forms of feedback to shape design and roadmap decisions.
* Set the standard for piloting and rolling out new capabilities - define objectives, scope, communication, training, support, and feedback/metrics to ensure successful adoption.
* Develop and maintain deep relationships with delivery partners including senior leaders, Digital, Technology, Design, Operations, Servicing, Legal, Risk & Control functions across the International Region
* Work hand-in-hand with Technology and Design, but you'll also be out front—engaging with Advisors and Business Management throughout the product lifecycle to make sure we're always building the right thing, the right way.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in Digital or financial services, with experience leading strategic or transformational change in wealth management, digital banking, or a related business.
* A proven innovator with an ability to think differently, reframe problems and uncover opportunities to turn emerging ideas into meaningful outcomes.
* Experience managing product delivery across multiple workstreams, balancing shifting priorities and complexities to successfully deliver new products to market.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Summary
  
  
Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
  
  
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. As a member of the Digital and AI team, you will play a pivotal role in driving process improvement, automation, and digitization across Client Services, spanning onboarding, implementation, configuration, testing, licensing, service delivery, issue resolution, and optimization processes.

This role will help identify and prioritize opportunities, translate complex user and business needs into scalable product capabilities and clear requirements, support technical solutioning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and contribute to measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

They have experience contributing to digital, automation, or AI-enabled products from discovery and prototyping through production, adoption, and continuous improvement. They will contribute to shaping the future of Client Services platforms and solutions, ensuring exceptional client and employee experiences, operational efficiency, responsible AI outcomes, resilient operations, and seamless integration with Visa systems.

* Support the development of AI-enabled and automated products in partnership with product leaders and engineering, including use-case analysis, evaluating appropriate AI, automation, and human-intervention patterns, rapid prototyping, data and model readiness, evaluation criteria, human oversight, privacy and security controls, production deployment, observability, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Contribute to digital platform capabilities and workflow solutions that translate complex client and operational processes into intuitive, scalable product experiences, including requirements intake, process and solution design, business rules, decisioning, validation, approvals, integrations, execution, and continuous improvement.
* Prepare and communicate product recommendations, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and performance insights to cross-functional and senior stakeholders, escalating issues through product leadership as needed.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* 2 or more years of relevant product, business analysis, program, technology, operations, or related experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 1 or more years with an Advanced Degree (e.g., MBA, MS), including experience contributing to digital, platform, automation, or AI-enabled products or capabilities.
* Required: Demonstrated critical-thinking, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame business problems with guidance, challenge assumptions, evaluate qualitative and quantitative evidence, assess options and risks, and translate insights into recommendations and clear requirements.
* Required: Experience using AI technologies or contributing to AI-enabled products, including analyzing viable use cases, supporting prototypes, documenting data and model requirements, helping establish evaluation and success metrics, partnering with engineering or data science teams, and applying responsible AI, privacy, security, and human-oversight practices. Familiarity with generative AI and/or agentic AI is required.
* Required: Experience using, analyzing, or supporting enterprise digital, workflow, automation, or AI-enabled products, including documenting product requirements, complex business rules and workflows, data and integration needs, controls, validation criteria, and capabilities that simplify complex client and operational processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, JD, MD).
* Experience contributing to enterprise software, workflow, platform, automation, or AI products with multiple integrations, stakeholder groups, or operational dependencies, preferably in a client onboarding, implementation, or service-delivery environment.
* Working technical knowledge of enterprise systems, APIs, data architecture, integrations, cloud services, AI/ML concepts, model evaluation, and production monitoring, with the ability to analyze system dependencies and support feasibility and trade-off discussions.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way
* Strong analytical and systems thinking, with developing product judgment and the ability to evaluate client value, operational impact, technical feasibility, risk, and investment trade-offs.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Seller Payments
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.
  
  
In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.
  
  
This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Own the international product strategy and roadmap for eBay Balance across Canada, Australia, Europe, and additional non-U.S. markets.
* Identify the most valuable regional customer problems and determine where eBay Balance can create differentiated value for buyers and sellers.
* Design and improve the complete stored-value lifecycle, including how customers:

+ Receive or earn funds
+ Add or reload money
+ Hold and manage their balance
+ Spend funds back on the eBay platform

* Develop new product features, incentives, and customer experiences that increase activation, adoption, repeat usage, and spend.
* Build a market expansion framework that balances customer demand, business opportunity, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, and platform scalability.
* Lead products from discovery through launch and optimization, bringing structure and momentum to complex, ambiguous initiatives.
* Use customer research, behavioral data, financial analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, validate opportunities, and make high-quality product decisions.
* Define and own success metrics such as activation, funded accounts, reload behavior, balance retention, repeat usage, spend-through, and incremental business impact.
* Partner closely with the product leader responsible for U.S. eBay Balance to build shared platform capabilities while addressing market-specific customer and regulatory needs.
* Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, design, analytics, business, payments, operations, finance, risk, legal, and compliance.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and business results clearly to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Establish repeatable capabilities that allow eBay Balance to expand efficiently into additional markets over time.

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in payments, digital wallets, stored-value products, fintech, financial services, or commerce.
* A track record of shipping and scaling complex customer-facing products across multiple teams or markets.
* Solid understanding of payment flows, funding methods, money movement, wallet experiences, or account-based financial products.
* Demonstrated success driving product adoption, engagement, retention, or transaction growth - not simply delivering features.
* Experience translating ambiguous business opportunities into a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and executable product plan.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and data to make decisions.
* Experience influencing engineering, design, analytics, business, risk, compliance, and operational partners without relying on direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex topics and make clear recommendations to senior executives.
* High ownership, urgency, and resilience. You are energized by difficult problems, move decisively, and stay accountable from strategy through measurable results.
* A global approach and an appreciation for how customer behavior, regulation, payment infrastructure, and business models differ across markets.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Organization**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward, to progress, make the right financial decisions, and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy contribute to the impact we can make. Together, we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Our purpose**
: Building a brighter future for all.
  
  
**Business & Team**
As we continue our pursuit of NPS +30, we need to transform how we engage with customers and colleagues. This requires moving from a two-track digital versus assisted approach to a deeply personal and empathic end-to-end digital experience, enriched and augmented by our colleagues.
  
  
The Gen AI Domain within CDAO has been established to build the tools and capabilities needed across the Group and to lead the “Transformer Banking” initiative. The domain focuses on solution practices, tools and platforms required to leverage Large Language Models safely and effectively, rather than creating foundation models.
  
  
The domain is building technology platforms and tools such as the Gen AI Hub, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access and control planes; business platforms such as Customer Conversation Manager and Customer Activity Manager; and reusable patterns and practices for Gen AI-enabled solutions across CBA.
  
  
The team enables crews across CBA to use Generative AI as part of traditional solutions in a heavily regulated environment. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build strong team cultures, remain focused on customer needs, manage risk thoughtfully, and are passionate about enterprise transformation through Gen AI.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution**
As Product Owner, you will be accountable for a portfolio of Gen AI platforms and services used across CBA to solve important customer and colleague’s needs. You will deeply understand end-customer and internal-consumer needs, own the product roadmap, ensure the products meet those needs, and partner with the Group Practice Lead - Gen AI Solutions to drive customer success.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
Direct line reporting to CAL, Gen AI.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define the product vision, direction and goals for the development team.
* Work with knowledge engineers, prompt engineers, platform engineers, data scientists and analysts to build reliable, resilient and adaptable Gen AI applications and deployable solutions.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, features and user stories, ensuring the development team works on the highest-value outcomes.
* Use your engineering background to understand customer needs for platforms serving internal engineers and assess the feasibility of transformative business capabilities.
* Balance business partner demands with the long-term sustainability of products and services to optimize customer experience, NPS, cost and risk outcomes.
* Partner with SRE teams, consuming service owners, controls teams and risk communities to embed risk management and platform resilience.
* Manage delivery expectations and provide clear status reporting to technology and business stakeholders.
* Own the risks, costs and benefits of platforms and services, while driving reliability, testing practices and Responsible AI.
* Help engineering squads determine which parts of fast-evolving Gen AI solutions require variability and which require stability.
* Continue learning while delivering tangible customer outcomes.
* Act as an ambassador for Gen AI transformation across the bank, sharing knowledge and supporting an open learning culture.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 12-14 years of relevant experience.
* Product ownership experience delivering complex, high-profile digital capabilities, technology platforms and services.
* Strong understanding of banking workflows and customer experiences, such as dispute-management processes and orchestration of multiple workflows to execute a case.
* Engineering background in software development, data engineering or data science.
* Experience building and operating technology platforms used internally or externally within an organization.
* Experience leading engineering teams that build and scale distributed systems, tools and frameworks across public, private or hybrid cloud environments.
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, attention to detail, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to identify unmet needs and champion innovative experiences and product practices.
* Ability to drive safe and responsible Gen AI solutions by challenging technology limitations and improving systems, processes and methods.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud solution architecture, preferably AWS and Azure; exposure to services such as Amazon SageMaker or equivalent AI platforms is valuable.
* Strong software-development practices, including Git, debugging, automated testing and documentation.
* Experience or exposure to Python, TypeScript and/or C#.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Prompt engineering and non-deterministic automated testing.
* System Reliability Engineering, secure coding, and software security pipeline tools for installation, configuration, operation and monitoring.
* Customer engagement systems and workflow platforms.
* Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Power Platform, including Copilot Studio.

**Good to Have**

* Understanding of machine-learning models and how generative architectures such as GANs, VAEs and Transformers are deployed at scale across cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
* Hands-on knowledge of scalable AI application patterns, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access or control planes.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with developments in AI and machine learning.

**People Capabilities**
**Customer Focus:**
Creates value in every customer interaction and considers the total customer experience.
  
  
**Team and Culture:**
Inspires others to demonstrate CBA Group values and contributes to a passionate, high-performing culture.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Continuously improves and innovates to make experience simpler for customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Effective Communication:**
Communicates clearly and with impact to build understanding, engagement and commitment to action.
  
  
**Judgement:**
Uses CBA knowledge, industry information and financial drivers to guide decisions and actions.
  
  
**Drive Results:**
Takes initiative and accountability to achieve business outcomes.
  
  
**Education Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science.
  
  
If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.
  
  
We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.
  
  
Advertising End Date: 26/11/2026

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
Constantinople delivers a new era of AI-native banking. Constantinople provides banks with a fully-managed software and AI operational platform, which brings together customer experience, product, data, operations, compliance and infrastructure in a single platform.
  
  
Constantinople’s AI-native platform eliminates the need for expensive infrastructure, and replaces manual operational and compliance processes with AI at scale. By removing the operational complexity of banking, Constantinople enables our client banks to focus on their customers and the business of banking.
  
  
**The Role**
You will own the Payments product itself: the platform capability every client bank runs on, rather than the launch of any single client. Your job is to make Payments serviceable, manageable and competitive at scale across all of our client banks, current and future, as part of normal business-as-usual operation.
  
  
You will work closely with Software Engineering, Solution Engineering, Product Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance, and the Client Delivery team.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Payments product roadmap and prioritisation.
* Own new Payments platform capability, including its timeline and delivery commitments. You will build it as reusable capability for all of our clients on the platform, including new payment rail integrations, for example NPP , PayTo and BECS bulk payments in Australia, and their equivalents in other jurisdictions.
* Own payment orchestration and routing logic, and bulk and batch payment processing.
* Build out the requirements for scheme and payment rail connectivity, and work with the Technology team in owning the technical architecture: adapter design per rail and country, gateway integrations, and how payment state is managed across the platform.
* Own the configuration model, which gathers the specifications needed to streamline implementation for each new client that joins the platform.
* Work with second line to continue to develop the fraud and risk control framework for Payments across jurisdictions, and own its implementation.
* Own the serviceability and management of Payments functionality at scale, with every process automated end to end so no manual processing is needed, supported by self-service tooling for Operations and, where appropriate, clients, and designed to work for both day-to-day operations and risk and compliance oversight.
* Own client-facing reporting that gives client banks everything they need to understand and run their own payments business, including reconciliation, settlement and transaction reporting available to all clients.
* Evolve the Payments offering to stay competitive with modern fintech payments providers, both for our current market position and as the market moves, while helping build a best-in-class Product team that values collaboration, meaningful work and impact.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with significant time on payments products.
* You have built payment rail integrations or payment platform capability, and know how scheme and rail connectivity works in practice.
* You have a background in payment processing systems, messaging standards such as ISO 20022, and API-based integrations.
* You have worked with second line to develop and implement fraud and financial crime controls for payment products.
* You have designed payment processes and tooling together with Operations and Risk and Compliance, and you understand the regulatory requirements for payments in the markets we serve.
* You have built reusable platform capability for multiple clients, supported by a configuration model that streamlines implementation for each new client.
* You have a bias toward action, a problem-solving mindset, and a willingness to do whatever it takes to solve complex challenges.
* You explain technical detail clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* You have a track record of driving alignment across technical teams, business partners and external vendors.
* You cut through ambiguity to produce strategic insight and spot opportunities.
* Startup experience is valued highly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with more than one country's payment schemes.
* Experience at a modern fintech payments provider or a payments platform serving financial institutions.
* Experience building internal operations tooling.

**Application Process**
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been looking for, select the 'Apply Now' button below to submit your cover letter and resume. Use your cover letter to introduce us to you; we want to know who you are, what you've worked on and why you think you'd be a great addition to the Constantinople team.
  
  
**Inclusion**
*To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
*We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us. We will treat your request as confidentially as possible. In your email, please include your name and preferred method of contact, and we will respond as soon as possible.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Goodscore, our vision is simple: your credit should manage itself. Our AI agents continuously monitor your credit, identify problems, negotiate with lenders, help resolve overdues, manage payments and rewards and unlock better credit as your profile improves. What started in 2023 as personalised credit guidance is evolving into an intelligent credit partner that works for you 24/7. With 8M+ users, a $13M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, and a rapidly expanding credit marketplace, we’re in the next phase of our growth.

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Manager to own high-impact product areas from strategy → 0→1 → scale. You’ll work closely with the Founder, Product, Engineering, Design and business leadership to identify the biggest customer problems, define the product vision, make high-conviction bets and drive them through execution.

This is a role for someone who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps.

**What you’ll do**

* Own Product Strategy - Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for your product area. Identify high-impact opportunities through customer insights, data, market trends and first-principles thinking. Translate ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* Build 0→1 and scale products - Take products from problem discovery → product definition → launch → iteration → scale. Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality products quickly.
* Build AI-native experiences - Identify where AI and agents can fundamentally improve the credit experience, rather than simply adding AI features. Experiment with new AI capabilities, workflows and agentic experiences and turn emerging technology into simple, useful experiences for millions of consumers.
* Own outcomes, not outputs - Define north-star and product metrics. Monitor performance, identify opportunities and continuously improve the product. Balance user value, business impact and execution velocity.
* Lead cross-functional execution - Work across Engineering, Design, Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Operations. Create alignment around priorities and drive execution through ambiguity. Influence without authority and bring teams together around a clear product direction.
* Be relentlessly close to the customer - Talk to users, understand their financial behaviour and uncover unmet needs. Combine qualitative insights with data to make better product decisions. Build products that are simple enough for the next 10 million users.

**What we’re looking for**

* Exceptional academic and professional track record; IIT/NIT or equivalent undergraduate degree and/or top-tier MBA.
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally building consumer products at scale with experience owning products end-to-end, including 0→1 launches.
* Strong product sense and ability to turn ambiguous problems into simple, compelling products. Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; comfortable working with data and product metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Genuine curiosity about AI, fintech, consumer technology and emerging products.
* Experience with AI/ML products, fintech, lending, credit, payments or marketplaces is a strong plus.

*GoodScore is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for ability, potential and impact, and welcome talented people from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, caste, religion, race, ethnicity, age, disability, marital or parental status, nationality, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Different perspectives make better products. We’re building a team that reflects the users we serve.*
