jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Product Portfolio & Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. The role provides a single senior orchestration point across Business, Product, Engineering, QA, Production Support, Cloud / Infrastructure, InfoSec, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance and partners. The incumbent must combine strong subject command with executive presence, structured problem solving and the authority to challenge commitments, resolve cross-functional conflicts and drive timely decisions.

  

**Key Responsiblities:**

  

**a) Portfolio strategy translation:** Convert approved business and product priorities into an integrated execution plan, with outcomes, milestones, dependencies, decision points, investment needs and accountable owners.

  

**b) Executive stakeholder management:** Build trusted relationships with senior Business and Technology leaders. Frame issues clearly, align divergent viewpoints, secure decisions and maintain confidence through fact-based, proactive communication and tracking with proper timelines and RCAs as applicable.

  

**c) Integrated planning and prioritization:** Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision.

  

**d) Governance and decision architecture:** Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline.

  

**e) Delivery assurance:** Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies.

  

**f) Cross-programme dependency management:** Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery.

  

**g) Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage.

  

**h) Commercial and vendor governance:** Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners.

  

**i) Financial governance:** Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

  

**j) Release and operational governance:** Ensure major releases have business, QA, Engineering, security, infrastructure, support and rollback readiness. Review recurring incidents, RCA closure and stability actions without taking over functional ownership.

  

**k) Regulatory and audit readiness:** Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes.

  

**l) Capability and standards:** Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators.

  

**Requirements:**

  

* Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is desirable.
* Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone.
* Proven leadership of multiple, concurrent, high-complexity programmes involving business, product, engineering, operations and external partners.
* Strong understanding of lending journeys and lifecycle, including acquisition, underwriting, disbursement, servicing, collections, customer channels and partner integrations.
* Working command of agile, hybrid and milestone-based delivery; ability to challenge plans, dependencies, solution assumptions and release readiness.
* Experience with executive governance, programme financials, vendor contracts, implementation partners, risk management and organisational change.
* Ability to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, environments, security, cloud / infrastructure and production support sufficiently to ask the right questions and drive accountable closure.
* Experience in regulated financial services is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales - Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Function:** Enterprise Sales / Strategic Account Management

**Market Coverage:** India & Southeast Asia (SEA)

**Experience:** 5 to 9+ Years

  

**Role Purpose:**

  

The Enterprise Sales Capital Markets (Farmer / Strategic Account Management) role will be responsible for managing, retaining, and growing Azentio's existing Capital Markets customer relationships across India and Southeast Asia.

  

The role will focus on understanding each customer's business priorities, technology landscape, operational challenges, and transformation roadmap, and identifying how Azentio's broader portfolio can address those evolving needs.

  

A key expectation is to identify whitespace within existing accounts and drive incremental revenue growth through cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Azentio's product portfolio, while protecting existing revenue, expanding account penetration, and building long-term strategic customer relationships.

  

The successful candidate must possess strong BFSI domain expertise and proven experience in managing strategic BFSI accounts, with a demonstrated track record of driving business growth, achieving sales targets, and expanding customer relationships within this segment.

The individual should bring strong business and sales acumen, consultative selling capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to identify and convert opportunities into incremental revenue. Experience in managing large enterprise accounts, driving complex sales cycles, developing C-level relationships, and positioning technology solutions across the BFSI landscape will be essential. The candidate should also be comfortable operating in a dynamic and relatively unstructured environment, taking end-to-end ownership of accounts and proactively creating new business opportunities

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Strategic Account Management & Growth**

  

* Manage a portfolio of existing Capital Markets customers across India and SEA.
* Develop comprehensive account plans covering existing products, revenue, stakeholder relationships, customer priorities, whitespace, competitive presence, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Own account growth and develop clear strategies for increasing Azentio's share of wallet within strategic customers.
* Identify opportunities across business units, functions, geographies, and technology environments within existing accounts.
* Build a sustainable account-level pipeline for cross-sell, upsell, renewals, extensions, and new requirements.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape within each strategic account.

  

**Understanding Customer Needs & Consultative Selling**

  

* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business strategy, operational model, technology landscape, and transformation priorities.
* Engage customers proactively rather than waiting for requirements or RFPs to emerge.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to uncover new requirements.
* Understand the underlying business problem and map the appropriate Azentio products and capabilities to the customer's needs.
* Develop solution propositions and business cases aligned to customer objectives.
* Position Azentio as a strategic technology partner, rather than a single-product vendor.

  

**Portfolio Selling, Cross-Sell & Upsell**

  

* Develop a strong understanding of Azentio's broader BFSI portfolio and its relevance to Capital Markets customers.
* Identify whitespace opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Drive cross-sell and upsell by connecting customer business requirements with relevant Azentio solutions.
* Identify opportunities for additional products, modules, licenses, users, geographies, upgrades, integrations, or transformation initiatives.
* Work with Product and Pre-Sales teams to build integrated propositions where multiple Azentio capabilities can address customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain an account-level upsell and cross-sell roadmap for key customers."

  

**Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop trusted relationships with senior business, operations, technology, procurement, and leadership stakeholders.
* Expand relationships beyond existing contacts and build multiple stakeholder connections within each account.
* Conduct regular Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), customer reviews, and strategic account discussions to assess customer satisfaction, identify growth opportunities, and drive account expansion.
* Understand stakeholder priorities, influence levels, decision-making processes, and potential relationship risks.
* Maintain strong customer engagement through regular meetings, workshops, market visits, and executive interactions.
* Act as the commercial relationship owner and customer advocate within Azentio.

  

**Renewals, Retention & Commercial Expansion**

  

* Protect and grow existing account revenue through proactive management of renewals, extensions, upgrades, and commercial opportunities.
* Engage customers ahead of renewal cycles to identify potential risks and expansion opportunities.
* Drive commercial negotiations for renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Identify competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, or relationship risks early and develop appropriate retention strategies.
* Partner with internal teams to ensure customer commitments are addressed and commercial relationships remain healthy.
* Balance customer requirements with commercial quality, margins, contractual terms, and long-term account value.

  

**India & Southeast Asia Account Development**

  

* Manage and grow assigned strategic accounts across India and Southeast Asia.
* Develop an understanding of market-specific customer dynamics and business practices.
* Build strong customer relationships through regular in-person engagement.
* Candidates who bring strong market intelligence, industry insights, competitive awareness, and an understanding of emerging business opportunities across India and Southeast Asia, enabling them to identify new growth avenues and add strategic value to Azentio's business, will have an advantage
* Travel extensively across India and Southeast Asia based on customer and business requirements.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Technical
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Overview**

The Business Analyst-Technical plays an important role within RTP International, supporting the definition, prioritisation, and delivery of technology capabilities across our markets.

The role combines technical product management and business analysis responsibilities with ownership of feature and user story definition, as well as active participation in backlog management and quarterly planning ceremonies.

As part of the Technology Backlog Management team, you will work closely with Engineering and other cross-functional teams to support delivery governance through cross-market technology vulnerability and risk reporting and remediation.

**Role Responsibilities**

**Technology Backlog Management**

* Translate technology epics into well-defined
  **features, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria**
  .
* Maintain feature/user story
  **data quality**
  ensuring they are validated, mapped, and aligned to strategic objectives, with technical dependencies, customer outcomes, and delivery milestones captured.
* Participate in
  **team ceremonies**
  such as daily standups, sprint demo, and retrospective meetings, amongst others.
* Maintain
  **alignment**
  between technical requirements, and product outcomes throughout the feature lifecycle.
* Together with the platform lead, evaluate competing feature requirements and make informed
  **prioritisation and trade-off decisions**
  based on business / technology value, risk, and delivery capacity.
* Continuously track feature development, review product demonstrations against acceptance criteria and drive resolution of requirements or delivery gaps.
* Maintain high-quality
  **feature and technical documentation**
  that supports effective delivery, governance, and self-service.
* Ensure Jira Backlog health is maintained per Mastercard standards and guidelines.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, RDO, Bizops, Risk & Control, Corporate Security, and Operational Resilience stakeholders to elaborate and refine features and user stories.
* Support the delivery of key initiatives such as
  **Project Elevate**
  activities across RTP International, working across relevant workstreams and cross-functional stakeholder groups.
* Coordinate across interdependent teams to manage
  **feature dependencies, delivery risks, and cross-market outcomes**
  .

**Reporting**

Partner with stakeholders to provide accurate, concise, and decision-focused data across your assigned domain in RTP International to the agility enablement team and technology backlog management colleagues to support reporting, including:

* **Technology Backlog**
  intake, status, trends, and prioritisation.
* **QP Planning**
  committed and uncommitted outcomes
* **OKR**
  progress and achievement
* **Vulnerability**
  status and remediation progress
* **TIMS**
  progress and exceptions

Use reporting not only to communicate status, but to
**identify trends, exceptions and emerging risks and contribute to actionable insights into Product and Technology leadership**
.

**Qualifications**

* Overall
  **3-6 years of experience**
  as a Technical Business Analyst in enterprise-scale IT projects.
* Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills with tools such as
  **JIRA and Confluence**
  .
* Strong experience in
  **requirements elicitation, business process analysis, stakeholder management, and solution definition**
  .
* Expertise in writing
  **BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **REST APIs, microservices, system integrations, databases (Oracle/DB2/SQL), and enterprise application architecture**
  .
* Experience working in
  **Agile/Scrum teams**
  , facilitating backlog grooming, sprint planning, UAT, and release activities.
* Experience in
  **banking, payments, fintech, or other high-volume transaction processing environments**
  .
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Attention to detail with a commitment to producing high-quality results.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have :

* Technical background in software development or hands-on exposure to
  **Java/Spring Boot, React, or similar technologies**
  .
* Knowledge of
  **DevOps practices**
  , CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, Docker, and release management processes.

**Additional Information**

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Product Owner (SAP)
jobs.description:
**Product Owner**
Recruiter for this position: Vipin Yadav
  
  
Hiring Manager for this position: Jaya Dadlani
  
  
Division: Product Engineering O2C
  
  
Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.
  
  
Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to sit at the intersection of engineering and product for our Credit & Risk suite. This role is for someone who can go deep into ABAP, RAP and Fiori technical topics to design and guide developers, write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can implement and test without ambiguity, and — when dedicated QA capacity is limited — test the functionality themselves. Prior Product Owner experience is not required as long as strong Project Management and Agile delivery skills are in place.
  
  
The person will work closely with the Product Manager to understand, follow, and contribute to the Roadmap, and will collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting to explain the product, gather feedback, and turn it into actionable backlog items
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-dive into technical topics in SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori to design solutions and guide developers through implementation.
* Write clear, well-structured Epics and User Stories that are easy for developers and QA to implement and test.
* Perform hands-on testing / QA yourself for critical items when dedicated QA capacity is limited.
* Understand, follow, and actively contribute to the product Roadmap set by the Product Manager.
* Collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting teams — explaining the product, capturing feedback, and translating it into requirements.
* Bring significant/strategic topics to the Product Manager for joint discussion and decision-making.
* Apply a working understanding of SAP functional processes and Finance tables to ground technical decisions in real business context.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, active listening, and critical reasoning across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have:**

* Hands-on technical experience with SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori/UI5 — enough to design solutions and guide developers, not just review code.
* Strong Project Management / Agile delivery skills (Scrum, sprint planning, Backlog management) — Product Owner title/experience is not mandatory if this is solid.
* Basic understanding of SAP functional processes; exposure to Finance tables (e.g. BSEG, BSID, Credit Management tables) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can pick up and implement/test with minimal back-and-forth.
* Willingness and ability to personally execute QA/Testing when QA capacity is constrained.
* Proven experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, or external agencies — explaining a product and incorporating feedback.
* Excellent communication and active-listening skills, with strong critical reasoning to navigate ambiguous, technical, and business conversations alike.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Prior experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product/technical-lead role.
* Domain exposure to Credit Management, Credit Risk, Order to Cash (O2C), or Accounts Receivable.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration context).
* Familiarity with JIRA/Confluence or similar Agile tooling for Epics/Story and Roadmap management.
* Exposure to integrations with external credit bureaus/agencies (e.g. credit reporting or credit insurance providers). Exposure to AI/ML-driven features such as credit exposure or risk-prediction models.
* Prior experience working with Solution Architects and Consulting teams in a customer-facing capacity.

Next steps: Simply apply here via the internal job market - we will contact you as soon as possible. Good to know: We will contact you first - your current manager will not be informed about your internal application.
  
  
Your HR Contact for this position is: Vipin Yadav
  
  
This role is based in: Pune

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Senior Specialist Product Manager
  
  
Senior Product Manager, Business Experimentation & Optimization
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test & Learn.
  
  
Role
  
  
Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test & Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi-million-dollar decisions.
  
  
Develop product strategy derived from user research, market trends, customer pain points, and commercial priorities.
  
  
Translate a deep understanding of our users into an actionable roadmap. Leverage user research, market research, sales/marketing expertise, and usage data to inform priorities.
  
  
Own end-to-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, design solutions, write requirements, support development and testing, and measure impact to inform future decisions.
  
  
Work as a part of a cross-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with UX designers, engineers, and other product managers to improve our products.
  
  
Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
  
  
**All About You**
Can work closely with cross-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
  
  
A quick learner with the ability to multi-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
  
  
Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
  
  
Creative problem-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
  
  
Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.

jobs.description:
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision and the roadmap :
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.
* Own product metrics end to end : turnaround time, accuracy, coverage, adoption and revenue per product line.
* Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap to move the needle on ARR, Retention, and ACV, in collaboration with the GTM teams.
* Stay close to customers and regulators :
* Spend time every week with credit, risk, legal and operations teams at banks, NBFCs and HFCs. Know their workflows better than they do.
* Track RBI, NHB and CERSAI direction and public infrastructure such as ULI, and build ahead of it instead of reacting to it.
* Sit in on key enterprise deals and renewals, and bring back what the product needs to win the next one.
* Ship, hands-on :
* Write specs, prototype with AI tools and review output quality yourself. This is a player-coach role.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Acquisition and Data Science to balance speed with platform reliability and compliance-grade accuracy.
* Make AI a product advantage : document understanding in 14 languages, title reasoning and automated risk signals that a credit officer can trust and audit.
* Drive adoption and ARR with GTM and Sales :
* Co-own adoption and ARR targets with the Sales and GTM leads. A product is not shipped until customers are using it and paying for it.
* Work on positioning, messaging and launch content, so the market understands what each product does and why it matters to a lender.
* Equip Sales and Customer Success with demos, proof points, ROI cases and competitive answers, and join key pitches, renewals and expansion conversations.
* Run a tight loop on win/loss reasons, usage data and customer feedback, and use it to grow usage and revenue within existing accounts.
* Own pricing and monetization :
* Leverage experience in B2B SaaS to make informed decisions around monetization, pricing, and product enhancements that help grow ARR and ACV.
* Lead and grow the team :
* Hire, coach and raise the bar for product managers and designers.
* Set a lightweight operating rhythm for discovery, prioritization, releases and feedback loops with Sales and Delivery.
* Represent product to the board, investors, customers and ecosystem partners.
* Foster a culture of low ego, high impact, and continuous learning.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers.
* You have owned a B2B platform, API or data product end to end and scaled it from early traction to a large customer base.
* Experience selling into or building for regulated enterprises, ideally banks, NBFCs or insurers, with long sales cycles and compliance reviews.
* First-principles thinking : you can break an ambiguous problem into bets, and show the data behind your calls.
* High agency and low ego. You do whatever part of the PM job the week demands.
* AI-native in how you work and what you build. You have shipped products where ML or LLM output quality was the product.
* Experience with data products where coverage, freshness and accuracy are the core metrics.
* Comfort with pricing and packaging for enterprise and usage-based API models.
* A track record of hiring and growing strong PMs.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience taking a B2B data asset into a consumer or partner-led product.
* Background in lending, mortgage, credit risk, collateral or fintech infrastructure.
* You have been a founder or an early leader at a company through Series A to C.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Impact : property is India's largest asset class and its least liquid. Your work decides how fast credit reaches homeowners, small businesses and farmers.
* A real moat to build on : a property dataset and identity layer that took years to assemble, with live banking customers already using it.
* Ownership : a leadership seat, direct access to founders, board and customers, and meaningful equity.
* Compensation and benefits : Competitive salary, ESOPs, health cover, leave policy and other benefits.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Trading
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Product Manager-Trading will collaborate with the other Trading Product Managers and Trading Product Leads to help guide the vision for Trading, OMS, and IBOR products. We are building this product suite anew and collaborating with our design team to improve the advisor/trader facing workflows and build engaging experiences that scale. You will execute product vision, implement strategy, and collaborate with a cross-functional team in a manner that improves their efficiency and productivity.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

jobs.title: Walk-in || Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Jr. Software Support Engineer LMS

**Department:** Learning & Development

**Location:** Pune

**Employment Type:** Contractual

**Experience Required:** 2 to 3 Years

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Computer Applications

(BCA/MCA)

  

**1. Job Purpose**

The Jr. Software Support Engineer will support the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and operational

functioning of the organisations LMS. The role includes managing user accounts and course assignments,

maintaining accurate reports, preparing and uploading digital learning content, conducting learning platform testing,

supporting system enhancements and migration activities, and resolving platform-related queries from trainers and

other stakeholders.

  

The role requires attention to detail, technical troubleshooting skills, data accuracy, and effective coordination with

internal teams to ensure reliable platform operations and continuous improvement.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Learning Platform Administration and Operational Support**

* Create and maintain user accounts, ensuring accurate user profiles, roles, locations, and project mappings.
* Manage course enrolments, programme assignments, user deactivations, and other learning platform

administrative activities.

* Monitor platform activities and screenshots as per the defined schedule.
* Track and resolve platform access and assignment-related issues within established timelines.
* Maintain records of platform activities and conduct periodic operational compliance checks.
* Ensure accurate batch and programme mapping across the platform.

**B. Reporting and Data Management**

* Extract, validate, consolidate, and maintain platform data for operational and management reporting.
* Prepare and submit weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports within defined timelines.
* Maintain trackers for user accounts, course assignments, enrolments, completions, and other platform activities.
* Verify report accuracy against source data and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain appropriate report version control and documentation.
* Provide timely and accurate data to support internal reviews and management decisions.

**C. Digital Content Development and Assessment Management**

* Convert and upload learning content in SCORM-compatible formats, where required.
* Create quizzes, assessments, and question banks aligned with course learning objectives.
* Map assessments to relevant courses and configure scoring, pass/fail criteria, and completion triggers.
* Test uploaded content for compatibility, functionality, and playback before publishing.
* Incorporate feedback and content revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain content quality standards and ensure accurate course configuration.

**D. Quality Assurance and Learning Platform Testing**

* Prepare and execute test cases for learning platform releases, updates, and enhancements.
* Identify, document, and report software defects, errors, and functional issues.
* Conduct retesting after bug fixes and validate enhancements before deployment.
* Perform regression testing to confirm that existing platform functionalities continue to work as expected.
* Validate data migration, including user records, course completions, and assessment scores, where applicable.
* Maintain test documentation, defect trackers, and quality assurance reports.
* Coordinate with developers and relevant stakeholders to support issue resolution and platform stability.

**E. Stakeholder Support and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical and operational support to trainers and internal stakeholders for learning platform-related

queries.

* Troubleshoot user access, course assignment, assessment, and platform usage issues.
* Maintain a query tracker documenting issue details, status, resolution, and closure.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate team and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
* Guide trainers on platform processes and the correct use of learning tools.
* Participate in mandatory internal training and undertake regular technical upskilling.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform processes, documentation, reporting, and user experience.

**F. Skills and Competencies Required**

* Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

  

Our Make Web Media is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Digital Marketing Project Coordinator to manage client communication and coordinate with internal teams for the smooth execution of digital marketing projects. The candidate will be responsible for client onboarding, understanding project requirements, coordinating with Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, Graphic Design and Website Development teams, tracking project progress, managing deadlines, handling client queries and ensuring timely project delivery. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication, organizational and follow-up skills, along with a basic understanding of digital marketing and the ability to manage multiple client accounts efficiently.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

**1. Client Communication & Relationship Management**

* Communicate with clients regularly to understand their requirements, expectations and feedback.
* Handle client calls, WhatsApp communication and emails professionally.
* Collect content requirements, approvals, feedback, images, videos and other necessary inputs from clients.
* Share updates regarding ongoing activities, deliverables and pending approvals.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients and ensure timely responses to their queries.

**2. Internal Team Coordination**

* Coordinate between clients, digital marketing executives, graphic designers and other internal departments.
* Communicate client requirements clearly to the concerned team members.
* Follow up on pending tasks, creatives, content approvals and campaign-related requirements.
* Ensure that deliverables are completed within the agreed timelines.
* Track daily tasks and maintain proper records of client communication and work progress.

**3. Content Planning & Creation**

* Plan monthly social media content calendars for clients.
* Create engaging and relevant content for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
* Write captions, social media posts, ad copies, headlines and promotional content.
* Develop content ideas for static posts, carousels, reels and video creatives.
* Understand client businesses and prepare content according to their target audience, brand positioning and marketing objectives.
* Coordinate with graphic designers and video editors to get creatives developed.

**4. Social Media & Digital Marketing Coordination**

* Coordinate social media posting schedules and ensure timely publishing.
* Follow up on content approvals and pending creative requirements.
* Monitor social media deliverables and maintain monthly content trackers.
* Support the digital marketing team with campaign content, client inputs and creative requirements.
* Prepare basic client updates and activity reports.

**5. Reporting & Task Management**

* Maintain client-wise task trackers and content calendars.
* Ensure all client requirements and feedback are documented.
* Monitor pending tasks and proactively follow up with the concerned team members.
* Escalate delays, client concerns and execution-related issues to management.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* 1-3 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Client Servicing, Social Media Management or a similar role.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong content writing and copywriting abilities.
* Understanding of Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
* Ability to plan social media content calendars and generate creative content ideas.
* Comfortable communicating with clients through calls, WhatsApp and emails.
* Good coordination, follow-up and task management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Docs, MS Office and basic digital marketing tools.
* Knowledge of creative concepts will be an added advantage.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and professional communication are essential.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect- Tech & Cloud Advisory
jobs.description:
**ZS**   is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it , our most valuable asset is our people. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning; bold ideas; courage an d passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.   
  
   
  
   
  
**Our most valuable asset is our people**  .   
  
At **ZS**  we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are and   
  
make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are part of your success here. Learn more about our diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces, obtaining the resources they need to thrive, and sharing the messages they are passionate about.   
   
ZS’s Digital and Technology group focuses on driving end to end Digital Transformation that includes Digital Strategy, Human centered Design, exploiting emerging technologies, and purposeful change management to improve customer and company results. The types of solutions include Digital Strategy and Advisory services, end to end Transformation Management, Enterprise Data, Analytics and AI, Intelligent Automation, reimagining business processes with digital first lens and building Digital Products, Solutions and Digital Platforms leveraging Big Data Technologies, AI/ML and Advance Analytics, Digital Platform configuration and integrations. We provide a complete spectrum of technology solutions, from strategy and roadmap definition to full scale implementation and on-going operations. Our team possesses deep expertise in leading digital transformation, enterprise data analytic and AI, Data science and advanced analytics and building end to end digital.   
  
   
  
**Manager- Enterprise Architect in Tech and Cloud Advisory**     
  
ZS's Technology Advisory Group ensures our future information, technology and architectural landscape is built to plan and evolve as our business grows, striving to balance future-proofing our end-to-end technology stack while accelerating the speed of innovation and streamlining the delivery of business capability.- This role will be responsible for supporting the growth and development of our Technology Advisory Practice within the ZS Technology Services business.   
    
     
    
  The successful candidate will work closely with ZS practice leadership and be responsible for evolving our practice, enriching our practice assets and collaterals, building, and managing client relationships, generating new business engagements, and providing thought leadership in the Technology and Architecture Area.   
    
  **What You’ll Do**
- Design robust and scalable solutions consistent with ZS and industry practices; take advantage of the existing assets and maintaining a balance between architecture requirements and specific client needs
- Drive technical architecture and design discussions with internal and client groups to brainstorm and finalize technology solutions
- Collaborate with the Architecture & Engineering expertise centre leadership to define technology roadmap and work with delivery team to put together a plan for technical implementation with and stay on track
- Stay current on latest technology trends and architecture patterns, and lead the effort to develop ZS POV for strategic decision-making
- Engage with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions.
- Advance ZS’ technology offerings by innovating and scaling tech assets, driving feasibility analysis to select technologies/platforms that provide the best solution
- Define and establish a technical strategy, standards, and guidelines in the data architecture domain
- Groom junior team members and maintain a culture of rapid learning and explorations to drive innovations / POCs on emerging technologies and architecture patterns
- Participate and support the business development activities.
  
**What You’ll Bring**     
- Bachelor's degree with specialization in Computer Science, IT or other computer related disciplines
- 8+ years of relevant experience in designing semantic architecture at an enterprise-scale.
- Strong engineering mindset to build highly available and robust architecture frameworks, technology solutions and reusable assets
- Expertise in one or more of initiatives like cloud strategy, IT transformation, and application portfolio assessment.
- Excellent communication and client engagement skills and ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
- Experience in providing architecture alternatives, product evaluation and recommendations, POVs for implementation/adoption .
- Experience in scaling technology solutions aimed at solving complex business problems.
- Knowledge of all phases of solution development for large-scale solutions and experience working in agile teams with short release cycles.
- Strong technical team leadership, mentorship and collaboration abilities.
  
**Perks & Benefits:**    
ZS offers a comprehensive total rewards package including health and well-being, financial planning, annual leave, personal growth and professional development. Our robust skills development programs, multiple career progression options and internal mobility paths and collaborative culture empowers you to thrive as an individual and global team member.   
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.   
  
**Travel:**    
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.   
  
**Considering applying**    
At ZS, we're building a diverse and inclusive company where people bring their passions to inspire life-changing impact and deliver better outcomes for all. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and recognize the value that candidates with all backgrounds, including non-traditional ones, bring. If you are interested in joining us, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements listed above.   
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.   
  
**To Complete Your Application:**    
Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment.An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.   
  
NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

The Sales Support Representative (SSR) delivers prompt transactional support to Account Executives (AE) and Area Sales Directors (ASD) by preparing quotes, cost proposals, pilot orders, drop shipments, and implementations via a CRM system. The SSR handles transactional tasks so AEs and ASDs can concentrate on selling and building relationships, driving revenue and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cost Proposals/Quotes**
  + Create and assist with cost proposals and quotes using the Salesforce (CRM) within the established service level agreement (SLA) timeframe.
  + Ensure pricing accuracy and compliance with approval workflows with each quote.
  + Generate standard and customized quote documents for customers.
* **Implementation/Gratis, Sample Orders, and Pilots**
  + Process, monitor, and track implementation/gratis requests based on established guidelines by product, Line of Business (LoB), or unique conditions.
  + Submit and track sample orders. Provide detailed information for custom shipments and labeling.
  + Execute pilot orders following the established guidelines and directions from the HMH Pilot team.
* **Sales Operations**
  + Handle inbound requests for quotes, samples, implementation/gratis, etc., from AE and ASD teams.
  + Research product availability, pricing, and tracking information.
  + Escalate issues to management when necessary.
* **Systems Tools**
  + Develop and maintain working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP, Sales Hub, and Customer Care platforms.
  + Perform daily sales transactions via SFDC and maintain organized records of sales activities.
* **Collaboration Communication**
  + Liaise with sales support team members and internal departments to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  + Participate in process improvement initiatives and team meetings.
  + Provide clear, concise, and frequent updates related to transaction status with Sales Support manager(s), AEs, ASDs, etc.

* **Adaptability** Maintain effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment, adjusting effectively to work within new work structures, processes, or requirements.

* **Communication** Clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that helps them understand and retain the message.
* **Continuous Improvement** Originating action to improve existing conditions and processes; identifying improvement opportunities, generating ideas, and implementing solutions.
* **Time Management** Effectively manages one's time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.
* **Technical / Professional Knowledge and Skills** Having achieved a satisfactory level of technical and professional skill or knowledge in position-related areas; keeping up with current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** AA/BS/BA degree
* **Experience:** 3-5 years sales support experience required.
* **Skills:**
  + Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel).

  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Ability to work in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Stationary position for a considerable time (sitting and/or standing).
* Constantly operates a computer

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist (WT- Contact Center (Ops))
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**

As an Associate Product Manager at Alacriti, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and development of our cloud-native money movement and payments platform. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, performant, and developer-friendly payment solutions that delight users and accelerate digital transformation for our financial clients. We are seeking candidates with 3+ years of product management experience, specifically with a track record of owning platform, API, or developer-facing products end-to-end.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop the long-term vision and strategy for the product and create and execute on a compelling roadmap
* Build deep user empathy with Alacriti’s clients and partners, understanding global payment industry trends and competitors' offerings to influence the roadmap effectively
* Collaborate with engineering, design and other teams to jointly shape product experiences that delight end-users
* Ensure we are building a reliable, performant platform, including system reliability, API extensibility, and latency
* Use metrics to inform point of view and leverage analytics to measure success
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for precise and concise articulation of user problems
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments (e.g., holdback tests), and using data to measure product impact on revenue, adoption and margins
* Experience working on products that require aligning multiple stakeholders, developing joint roadmaps, and navigating competing priorities between internal goals and external partner objectives
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility
* Strong business acumen and comfort with complex ecosystem and platform-level problems

**Who you are**

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

* You are a product builder who can move easily between a user’s hardest problem, the business opportunity behind it, and the product decisions needed to solve it.
* You have worked on technically complex products - such as APIs, developer tools, shared platform capabilities, or core product experiences - but you do not build tech/platform for its own sake. You see strong platform design as a way to help users move faster, create better products, and unlock new business models.
* You are opinionated, thoughtful, and execution-oriented. You can focus a team on the few decisions that matter most, create momentum in ambiguous situations, and ship products that raise the bar for both quality and impact.

Key Requirements

* **Product Management Experience:**
  3+ years of experience in Product Management, with end-to-end ownership of platform, API, or developer-facing products.
* **Product Strategy and Execution:**
  Demonstrated experience in roadmap development, feature prioritization, product delivery, and outcome measurement.
* **Payments and FinTech Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of payment processing, money movement, transaction flows, payment ecosystems, or financial technology products.
* **Technical Product Understanding:**
  Ability to work with APIs, platform capabilities, technical requirements, and engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* **Data-Driven Decision-Making:**
  Experience defining product success metrics, analyzing performance data, and measuring business impact.
* **Customer-Centric Mindset:**
  Strong problem-discovery skills and the ability to translate user needs into effective product solutions.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams and external partners.
* **Business Acumen:**
  Ability to understand business models, customer value, revenue opportunities, and complex platform-level challenges.
* **Go-to-Market Collaboration:**
  Experience working with Sales and Marketing teams on product launches, positioning, enablement, and adoption.
* **Execution and Ownership:**
  Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Education:**
  B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.
* **Domain Experience:**
  Prior experience in payments, FinTech, banking technology, or financial infrastructure is an advantage.
* **Platform Product Experience:**
  Experience converting customized or client-specific solutions into scalable, reusable product capabilities.
* **API and Developer Products:**
  Experience building or managing API-first products, developer-facing platforms, or technical integrations.
* **Strategic Product Thinking:**
  Ability to anticipate future customer needs and make well-judged foundational product investments.
* **Experimentation and Analytics:**
  Experience with product experiments, holdback tests, performance measurement, and data-driven optimization.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description:
**Role : Sr UX Designer
  
  
Job Type : Full Time**
**Location : On-site, Hyderabad**
(Work From Office)
  
  
**About HugoHub**
Hello and Welcome!
  
  
HugoHub is the intelligent foundation for the future of finance, providing a modular banking platform that empowers financial institutions to move at speed.
  
  
Designed to simplify the path to digitization for small and medium-sized banks, the platform consists of both backend core platform and frontend experience layer that offer a full suite of modular banking services through a single integration. By embedding intelligence and compliance directly into its architecture, HugoHub enables financial institutions to launch specialized products, automate back-office complexity, and scale with unparalleled efficiency.
  
  
HugoHub is a B2B platform with multiple offices across Singapore, India, United Kingdom, Indonesia, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is owned by Atlas Consolidated Pte Ltd.
  
  
****Atlas****
**Atlas Consolidated Pte Ltd. is Headquartered in Singapore.**
**A regulated entity with strong credentials**
Atlas Consolidated Pte Ltd satisfies stringent corporate governance, operations, and regulatory integrity requirements to maintain licences from regulatory bodies, such as:
  
  

* Monetary Authority of Singapore - Major Payment Institution licence and Financial Advisors licence
* Ministry of Law, Singapore - Regulated Precious Metals Dealers licence
* Visa Inc. - Principal Members Issuing licence

**Who are we looking for?**
**UX Designer**
for our HugoHub Design Team, with strong expertise in user experience design, research-driven problem-solving, and system-based design thinking.
  
  
As a UX Designer at HugoHub, you’ll be part of building experiences that shape the way users across the world interact with our fintech ecosystem. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design peers to craft thoughtful, intuitive, and scalable solutions for complex problems, balancing business goals with user needs.
  
  
**We’re Looking For Someone Who**

* Stays curious, updated, and keeps learning to grow as a designer.
* Questions norms to continuously improve and elevate user experiences.
* Empathises deeply, reimagines creatively, and designs with clarity and intent.
* Applies a systems-based approach to build scalable, cohesive design patterns.
* Breaks down and solves problems from the ground up with structured thinking.
* Collaborates across teams and proactively drives meaningful design improvements.
* Communicates design rationale confidently, backed with research and user insights.
* Manages time effectively, balancing exploration, iteration, and sound decision-making.

**Required Qualification**

* 6-8 years of relevant experience in UX Design.
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication Design, Human–Computer Interaction, or a related field is preferred.

**Must Have Skills**

* Strong foundation in UX methodologies with proven experience in user research, testing, and translating insights into user-centered design.
* Ability to explore multiple design approaches and adapt based on feedback and testing.
* Deep understanding of Information Architecture and designing intuitive navigation systems.
* Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with established UX workflows.
* Leadership qualities to mentor junior designers and contribute to design standards and practices across the team.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience designing for B2C and B2B products, especially mobile-first experiences.
* Exposure to fintech domain projects and data-rich experiences.
* Ability to design clear, engaging layouts that simplify complex data.
* Advanced prototyping skills to create interactive prototypes for usability testing and iteration.

**How will you contribute to the company?**
You’ll collaborate with PMs, developers, fellow UX and UI designers to:
  
  

* Gather insights, advocate for users, and design thoughtful, data-informed fintech experiences.
* Communicate and present ideas, user flows, and prototypes to drive alignment across teams.
* Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and translate insights into impactful design improvements.
* Share and receive design feedback openly, growing together as a design team.
* Ship products and continuously refine experiences that thousands of users engage with daily.
* Own end-to-end design delivery across multiple product initiatives.
* Mentor interns and junior designers to build a strong design culture.
* Proactively improve the team’s design and development processes.

**HugoHub values being Responsible, Open, and Collaborative.**
You should be passionate about what HugoHub stands for:
  
  

* Honest, truthful and open communication at all times with the team members.
* We are responsible to our customers, community, and team to help shape a more open, collaborative approach to wealth. This is how HugoHub hopes to make a difference and help us build better communities.
* Shared responsibility is not only part of our approach to wealth but also a key part of working together. This shared responsibility allows for openness and candour between us as a team and in our customer relationship.
* Good ideas can come from anywhere, so an open and collaborative dialogue between the HugoHub community (customers, team, and stakeholders alike) helps us all get the best from each other and makes a difference. Everyone is welcome to apply.

**Curious To Know More**
Find and follow us here: Linkedin
  
  
Join us on a mission to simplify complexity in finance through the use of applied, intelligent, deep technology!
