jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Product Manager (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for an AI agent platform that serves
  
  
Mastercard issuers and acquirers - enabling non-technical financial operations teams to surface insights, investigate anomalies, and act on reconciliation data through natural language. You will define what gets built, sequence when it gets built, and ensure every decision is grounded in measurable customer and business value. You work at the intersection of customer discovery, AI capability, and compliance - and you are comfortable making hard prioritization calls in all three dimensions simultaneously.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the AI agent platform: define the vision, articulate the roadmap, and maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects real customer need, business impact, and delivery

feasibility.
  
  

* Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and

distinguish symptoms from root causes.
  
  

* Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you

for clarification.
  
  

* Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
* Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
* Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering

enthusiasm or conservatism.
  
  

* Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those

constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.
  
  

* Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
* Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
* Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
* Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
* Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
* Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
* Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
* Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
* Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
* Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
* Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
* Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
* Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually

meets the product intent.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Role Title: AVP - Enterprise Client Computing Product Owner (L11)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview:**
The AVP - Enterprise Client Computing Product Owner function is accountable for engineering, automating, and securing Synchrony’s end-user compute platforms across Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, and Virtual Desktop environments (e.g., Citrix / Horizon / AWS WorkSpaces / Cloud PC). The team drives modern endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and co-management (SCCM), with strong ownership of software packaging, patch orchestration, OS lifecycle management, endpoint configuration standards, and performance telemetry.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The AVP - Enterprise Client Computing Product Owner is accountable for the operational ownership, service reliability, security, compliance, financial stewardship, and continuous improvement of enterprise client computing services. This role leads endpoint run operations and product management across Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, VDI, AWS WorkSpaces, Cloud PCs, and related technologies. The Product Owner partners with engineering, infrastructure, information security, risk, service management, business stakeholders, and strategic vendors to deliver a secure, stable, high-performing, and user-focused employee computing experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end operational lifecycle management for desktops, laptops, Macs, Chromebooks, AWS WorkSpaces, VDI, Cloud PCs, and associated endpoint services.
* Manage service health, availability, capacity, performance, adoption, lifecycle outcomes, and achievement of agreed service levels.
* Lead incident triage, major incident response, service restoration, problem management, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Oversee patching, software distribution, configuration standards, endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, compliance reporting, encryption, certificates, and privileged access controls.
* Own the client computing product roadmap, backlog, priorities, key performance indicators, quarterly release plans, and modernization outcomes in partnership with engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
* Drive Intune-first and Autopilot-first management, co-management, automation, self-service, endpoint analytics, and production readiness while reducing legacy SCCM-only dependencies.
* Govern operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, support handoffs, business continuity, disaster recovery readiness, and annual resiliency activities.
* Support endpoint onboarding, provisioning, refresh, decommissioning, platform transitions, Windows 11 migration, and VDI or Cloud PC rationalization.
* Use telemetry and analytics, including endpoint and digital employee experience data, to improve reliability, performance, adoption, and user experience.
* Partner with Information Security and Risk to maintain audit readiness and provide evidence supporting applicable SOX, PCI, third-party risk, and change governance controls.
* Manage strategic vendor and managed service partner performance, staffing coverage, service levels, continuous improvement commitments, and monthly or quarterly service reviews.
* Own endpoint operating budgets, software licensing, and asset forecasts, identifying cost optimization opportunities across hardware, software, and managed services.
* Provide executive-level service reviews, roadmap updates, risk visibility, and timely communications to senior leaders and stakeholders.
* Collaborate across India and US time zones and participate in after-hours support, planned maintenance, and major service events when required.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in endpoint management, desktop operations, digital workplace technology, product ownership, infrastructure, or client computing services.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise-scale client computing services in a complex, global environment.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11, macOS, ChromeOS, Citrix, AWS WorkSpaces, VDI, and Cloud PC technologies.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, SCCM/MECM co-management, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD join, Endpoint Analytics, and Windows Update for Business.
* Working knowledge of endpoint technologies such as JAMF, Tanium, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Nexthink, Google Admin Console, Azure, AWS, PowerShell, ServiceNow, and Power Automate.
* Strong understanding of IT service management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Service Level, Availability, Capacity, and Continuity Management.
* Experience supporting security, regulatory, compliance, and audit requirements, including vulnerability remediation and evidence management for SOX and PCI controls.
* Proven ability to own a product roadmap, backlog, KPI framework, operational priorities, vendor outcomes, budget considerations, and service improvement plans.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, analytical, financial, documentation, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate effectively across engineering, operations, infrastructure, security, risk, service desk, business teams, and vendors.
* ITIL v4 certification and Agile product ownership certification such as CSPO or PSPO.

**Desired Characteristics**

* ITIL v4 certification and Agile product ownership certification such as CSPO or PSPO.
* Experience operating endpoint services within a regulated financial services environment.
* Experience leading modernization and transformation initiatives involving Intune, Autopilot, co-management, cloud-native endpoint controls, Windows 11, VDI, or Cloud PCs.
* Demonstrated experience with automation, scripting, workflow optimization, proactive remediation, self-service, and continual service improvement.
* Strong data-driven leadership approach with experience using telemetry, service metrics, experience scoring, dashboards, and trend analysis to improve outcomes.
* Ability to balance operational stability, security, employee experience, modernization, cost optimization, and competing stakeholder priorities.
* Proven success managing strategic partners, global delivery teams, licensing, asset lifecycle planning, and service performance governance.
* Executive presence, ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex technical and operational matters clearly.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree with minimum 8 years of overall experience or in lieu of degree, minimum 8+ years of overall experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with Windows 10/11, macOS, ChromeOS, Citrix, AWS WorkSpaces, VDI, and Cloud PC technologies.

**Work Timings:**
3:30 PM- 12:30 AM IST
  
  
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams

jobs.title: Front End Developer - Manager
jobs.description:
Role purpose
  
  
You'll build the user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a
**hands-on senior development role**
. You'll build data-heavy, real-time ReactJS/TypeScript applications that replace legacy desktop and web UIs. You'll own front-end integration with back-end services over
**REST APIs, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE)**
. You'll also set front-end standards and tooling for the team, and use AI coding tools as part of your everyday work.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Front-end development**

* Design and build complex ReactJS/TypeScript applications for trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations monitoring users.
* Build high-performance, data-heavy UIs: large grids (e.g. AG Grid), virtualised lists, filtering, dashboards and live status views.
* Design reusable component libraries, state management (e.g. Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) and accessible, consistent UI patterns.
* Write clean, modern JavaScript (ES6+) and strongly typed TypeScript, and keep API contracts type-safe.
* You will have decent experience of understanding and changing Java backend code

**Real-time and API integration**

* Integrate with server-side services over REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, caching, retries and error handling.
* Build robust WebSocket clients (native WebSocket, STOMP or Socket.IO) for two-way, low-latency updates. Handle reconnects, heartbeats, back-pressure, message ordering and subscription management.
* Implement SSE streams for one-way server push (e.g. job status, cycle progress, alerts), including reconnection and event replay.
* Choose the right pattern (REST, WebSocket or SSE) for each use case, working with back-end engineers on message design and contracts.
* Make real-time screens perform well under heavy update volumes: batched rendering, memoisation and throttling.

**Build tooling and quality**

* Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm/pnpm and Vite, including workspaces/monorepos, dependency management, environment configuration and bundle optimisation.
* Work with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) for front-end build, test and deployment.
* Write unit, component and end-to-end tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress), and use mock servers for REST, WebSocket and SSE testing.
* Handle front-end security: SSO/MFA integration, token handling, XSS/CSRF protection and dependency vulnerability scanning.

**AI-assisted development**

* Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to speed up component building, refactoring, test generation and legacy UI analysis.
* Review all AI-generated code for correctness, accessibility, performance and security before merging.

**Leadership**

* Set front-end standards, review code and mentor other developers.
* Work with business analysts and users to turn legacy screens and workflows into modern, usable interfaces.
* Support releases, cutovers and early-life support.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years in software development, with 5+ years building production ReactJS applications.
* ReactJS: expert in hooks, context, component design, performance tuning and state management.
* TypeScript/JavaScript: strong in TypeScript (generics, typing API contracts) and modern JavaScript, including async patterns.
* Build tooling: practical experience with npm, pnpm and Vite (including migrating from Webpack or similar).
* WebSockets: strong experience building and supporting production WebSocket integrations, including reconnection and state recovery.
* SSE: practical experience using Server-Sent Events/EventSource for streaming updates.
* REST APIs: strong experience consuming and designing contracts with server-side services (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Decent Java knowledge
* Testing: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library and an end-to-end framework.
* Git, CI/CD and agile delivery.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional delivery.

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot back ends (e.g. Spring WebSocket/STOMP, SSE endpoints), to work well with back-end teams.
* Experience with Kafka-backed real-time UIs or streaming gateways.
* Experience replacing legacy UIs (GWT, PowerBuilder, desktop/Citrix applications).
* Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement or operations monitoring.
* Familiarity with AWS front-end hosting (S3/CloudFront, API Gateway WebSockets).

Success measures (first 12 months)
  
  

* Delivered production front ends for modernized applications, on schedule.
* Real-time features are stable under production load, with reliable reconnection and no data loss for users.
* Shared component library and front-end standards adopted across the team.
* Faster, smaller builds and good test coverage, measured against a baseline.
* Measurable productivity gains from AI tools, with no drop in quality.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

jobs.title: Accounts & Finance Manager – Cross-Border E-commerce
jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About Us**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Network International is the largest Financial Technology company in Middle East and Africa. Payments is our core business where we provide services in more than 50 countries – UAE, Jordan, South Africa, Egypt are some of our key markets. Apart from payments, we provide services on Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, Risk Solutions, etc. Our core customers are businesses at every scale and segment, though recently we are growing in direct to consumer card segment as well.
  
  
**Our EVP**
At Network International, we always stay ahead. . In the fast-paced world of financial services, we thrive on innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration. We invest first in our people, empowering you to make bold decisions, learn fast, and grow your expertise alongside industry leaders. Here, solving complex problems means more than using cutting-edge technology; it’s about creating meaningful value for our customers, together. We foster a culture where trust, accountability, and achievement go hand in hand—because success isn’t just a goal; it’s how we work, every day, as one team.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Head of Agile Transformation will lead Acquiring's evolution into a more product-led, agile and insight-driven organisation. Working across Product, Technology, Data, Business Teams, Leadership and Transformation Partners, the role will assess current maturity, define the target operating model and embed practical ways of working suited to Network International.
  
  
The role will create the governance, capabilities, roles and operating practices needed for successful product delivery, while delivery outcomes remain shared across Product, Technology and the wider organisation. As maturity increases, the remit will evolve towards broader product strategy, portfolio management, investment prioritisation and value creation.
  
  
**The Transformation Journey**

* Discover: Assess maturity and define the target state and roadmap.
* Transform: Establish the Product and Agile operating model.
* Embed: Build internal capability, a Centre of Excellence and partner knowledge transfer.
* Scale: Extend and continuously improve successful practices.
* Evolve: Broaden influence over Product strategy, portfolio choices and value creation.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Lead Product & Agile Transformation**

* Own the transformation vision, business case, roadmap, milestones and success measures; assess maturity and sequence priorities.
* Align Product, Technology, Data, business leadership and partners around a common target state, removing organisational, governance and behavioural barriers.
* Keep the transformation practical, commercially relevant and aligned with customer, risk and enterprise priorities, using AI-enabled tools to accelerate adoption.

**Establish Product-led & Agile Ways Of Working**

* Design and embed a scalable operating model covering team structures, governance, decision rights, funding principles, delivery cadences and performance measures.
* Clarify accountabilities across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, Data, Operations, Sales and delivery roles.
* Embed customer-led discovery, prioritisation and outcome-based planning; apply Scrum, Kanban or scaled approaches according to context.
* Improve Product-Technology collaboration, portfolio visibility, dependency management, predictability and speed to value.

**Build Capability & Organizational Ownership**

* Build Product and Agile capability from executive leadership to delivery teams through structured learning, coaching and practical application.
* Establish a Product and Agile Centre of Excellence, communities of practice, playbooks, role standards and internal coaching capability.
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change adoption; govern transformation partners and progressively transfer knowledge and ownership into Network International.

**Enable Insight-led Decisions & Demonstrate Value Through Data & AI:**

* Embed customer insight, product analytics, commercial measures and operational data into discovery, prioritisation and lifecycle decisions.
* Identify responsible uses of AI for research, experimentation, requirements, knowledge management and decision support, with appropriate human oversight and controls.
* Maintain a balanced scorecard covering adoption, capability, flow, predictability, quality, customer outcomes and commercial value; report progress, risks and benefits transparently.

**Qualifications**
**Key Requirements:**
**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years across Agile transformation, Product operating models, Product management, technology delivery or enterprise change, including 5+ years in senior leadership.
* Proven success leading large-scale Product and Agile transformation across multiple teams or business units in a complex, regulated organization.
* Strong experience designing Product-led operating models, including governance, roles, team structures, portfolio practices, outcome-based planning and investment prioritization.
* Hands-on expertise in Product discovery, Agile delivery, organizational design, change leadership, executive influence, coaching and capability building.
* Experience managing transformation partners, establishing a Centre of Excellence and transferring capability into internal teams.
* Track record of measuring adoption, delivery performance, customer impact and business value; practical understanding of responsible AI, data privacy and security.
* Experience in payments, acquiring, merchant services, fintech or banking, with knowledge of the merchant lifecycle, payment products, risk, fraud, operations and commercial drivers.
* Experience across multiple markets and regulatory environments, ideally in the Middle East and Africa.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is advantageous.
* Credentials such as SAFe SPC, Certified Scrum Professional, ICAgile, Scrum Alliance or Prosci are advantageous; demonstrated transformation outcomes are more important than certification alone.

*Network International is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, nationalities, and experience levels. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where innovation, diversity, and performance thrive.*

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

* Experience building products for analysts, investment teams, lenders, or risk professionals.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, valuation, leverage, and credit risk.

* Experience delivering enterprise software with measurable adoption and commercial impact, including direct customer discovery and engagement with senior financial stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**Location: Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah(Border of Dubai & Sharjah)**

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking a hands-on Marketing Director of Innovation, Menu & Markets to grow KFC, the biggest chicken brand in the region, across the GCC, Levant and Morocco. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day marketing operations and the innovation agenda for the brand across all operating markets. The role owns the innovation pipeline, the menu architecture and the end-to-end execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market, across dine-in, drive-thru and aggregator channels.

Provide advisory and center-of-excellence support to other markets as required. This includes strategic guidance during critical situations, recovery planning and support on key initiatives, such as strengthening menu and NPD plans, in collaboration with local teams.

**The right person is a true hustler: hands-on, action-oriented and relentless on execution, with a strong food palate, the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along, and a proven record of leading high-performing teams to drive operational and commercial excellence across markets.**

**Key Responsibility Areas:**

**Strategic Leadership: Future-proof the brand across Customer, Commercials, Competitiveness & Channels**

* Spot key customer and food trends early and shape brand strategy through relevant actions built into the 18-month plan that rolls into the AOP.
* Develop and execute an overarching marketing AOP that delivers on the brand’s strategic objectives across the geography.

**Market Windows & Execution Excellence: Own the local calendar, end to end**

* Own the planning and execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market (e.g. Ramadan, Eid, National Days, summer, back-to-school and key sporting and cultural moments), tailoring offer, price and communication to each market.
* Deliver flawless, on-time launches from concept to restaurant, covering product readiness, supply, training, POS, digital and aggregator activation, and close gaps with speed and minimal escalation.
* Run a disciplined launch cadence with clear timelines, owners and post-launch reviews; read results fast, fix what is not working and scale what is.
* Maintain a strong, hands-on presence in markets and restaurants to ensure plans land as intended and learnings are captured and shared across markets.

**Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and get things done**

* Drive cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders, including but not limited to the Franchisor, country GMs and Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Procurement and other business units, to deliver cohesive and impactful NPD and market initiatives.
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with country leadership teams; balance regional consistency with local market needs and negotiate trade-offs to land the best outcome for the brand.
* Manage agency, supplier and aggregator partner relationships to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

**Menu & NPD Leadership: Bring a strong food palate to every decision**

* Own the menu strategy and architecture across core, value, premium and limited-time offers, ensuring a balanced, profitable menu tailored to each market.
* Lead the culinary innovation agenda to enhance brand love and relevance, driving customer penetration and frequency through sustainable new product platforms.
* Bring a strong, discerning food palate to product development: lead taste panels, kitchen sessions and product sign-offs with R&D and suppliers, and push for products that win on taste, quality and consistency.
* Translate local flavor preferences and culinary trends into a robust NPD pipeline that is operationally feasible and commercially viable.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Continue to deliver industry-leading financial outcomes.
* Be accountable for commercial outcomes (transactions, average transaction value, sales and gross profit) for the brand in every operating country.
* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.
* Work with cross-functional teams to build a strong data- and learning-based marketing investment culture.

**Insights and Analytics: Role-model the use of data, while staying curious to spot trends that future-proof the brand**

* Use consumer research programs to refine the consumer model, conduct competitor analysis, track consumer habits and initiate product improvements to meet market needs.
* Leverage insights from dedicated brand analysts to inform decision-making, optimize innovation and address menu gaps.

**Team Leadership: Build an enviable, high-performing, cohesive working environment**

* Lead and manage a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across all eight operating markets: onboard, coach and mentor team members, set clear goals and hold the team accountable for delivery.
* Provide functional leadership to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership and innovation.
* Lead the brand agenda among cross-functional teams to accelerate delivery of the brand’s strategic objectives.
* Role-model Americana people practices and coach the team to build a strong talent bench.
* Be a strong advocate for the customer agenda within the KFC leadership team and a mentor for cross-functional teams.
* Be a flag bearer for Americana’s purpose, vision and strategy, instilling an ownership mindset and a bias for action.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 10–15 years of marketing leadership experience.
* Experience in QSR or retail is a must-have.
* Proven track record of managing marketing for multi-country, multi-channel portfolios in complex, high-transaction environments such as KFC or other global brands.
* Demonstrated success in owning and executing locally relevant campaigns and seasonal windows across multiple markets, on time and to a high standard.
* A strong food palate and genuine passion for food, with hands-on experience in menu management, NPD and product sign-off.

jobs.title: Vice President, Historical Market Data
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

Summary:

MUSO Enterprise Risk is seeking a Vice President to lead the Historical Market Data (HMD) function in Pune. HMD manages the market time-series data used to calculate Value at Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR) and other key market risk measures.

The VP of HMD, Pune will lead and develop the local team, own delivery of data onboarding and quality commitments, and work closely with the Mizuho Americas HMD team as one integrated global function. The role requires strong knowledge of financial markets, statistics and data management, together with proven people leadership and cross-regional stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership and Delivery

* Lead, manage and develop the Pune HMD team.
* Set objectives, allocate work, coach team members and manage performance.
* Own Pune delivery against the HMD roadmap, service commitments and risk-reporting deadlines.
* Escalate delivery risks, dependencies and control issues promptly.
* Establish clear hand-offs, escalation paths, priorities and shared delivery plans across time zones.

Historical Market Data Management

* Oversee end-to-end onboarding of spot, curve and volatility-surface time series.
* Lead complex or high-priority market-data implementations.
* Drive delivery of the HMD platform migration and enhancement programme.
* Identify data and technology issues and drive sustainable solutions through implementation.
* Ensure changes are tested, documented and implemented with appropriate controls.
* Oversee reporting on data quality, proxy usage and backfilling.
* Ensure accurate and timely communication of data issues and remediation to stakeholders.
* Support audit, regulatory and control requirements for market data used in risk measures.
* Build capability in Pune and promote knowledge sharing across the global HMD function.

Requirements:

* Master’s degree in Statistics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in financial services, market data, risk data or data analysis.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering through others.
* Strong track record in time-series onboarding, market-data management or comparable data programmes.
* Experience leading data migration, platform enhancement or control-improvement initiatives.
* Ability to simplify complex data and process flows and drive issues to resolution.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL and Excel, with sufficient depth to review and challenge team output.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across regions.

Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. * Professional certifications e.g. TOGAF.

Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps, and driving cross functional alignment.

The role is based out of Pune.

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures.
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Technology Lead - Tribe Passport & Cloud Engineering, VP
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Technology Lead - Tribe Passport & Cloud Engineering**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Corporate Title: VP**
**Role Description**

* The Technology Lead will provide hands-on technical leadership across Cloud Platform Engineering and Tribe Passport within the Architecture & Technology Office (ATO). The role will lead the design and delivery of reusable cloud engineering, automation and DevOps capabilities, and provide senior technical ownership of Tribe Passport, a strategic ATO platform for engineering and management insights.
* This hands-on Vice President role combines cloud platform engineering, software engineering, solution architecture, DevOps, automation and technical leadership. The successful candidate will take complex engineering challenges from concept to production, delivering secure, resilient and reusable solutions for adoption across multiple teams and applications.
* The role requires the ability to set technical direction and define architecture while remaining hands-on in code reviews, complex troubleshooting, design validation and critical implementations.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Platform Engineering & Automation**

* Lead complex cloud platform engineering and automation initiatives across ATO, translating recurring engineering challenges into reusable capabilities, patterns and self-service workflows.
* Design and deliver automation for areas such as landing-zone provisioning, infrastructure-as-code, environment setup, CI/CD, policy/control automation, application onboarding and operational readiness.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules, engineering templates, APIs and automation frameworks that standardize delivery while reducing manual engineering effort.
* Lead the design and adoption of reusable DevOps capabilities across GitHub Actions, Jenkins and TeamCity, reducing unnecessary platform-specific dependencies.
* Develop reusable CI/CD workflows supporting applications deployed across Google Cloud and on-premises environments, incorporating standard security, testing, release and deployment controls.
* Drive release and deployment automation, reducing lead time while maintaining OSS vulnerability, audit, segregation-of-duties and change-control requirements.
* Establish reusable approaches for dependency and software lifecycle management, enabling security and OSS fixes to be propagated consistently across application portfolios.
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership for complex cloud onboarding, remediation and migration activities involving GCP, container platforms, databases, CI/CD and infrastructure automation.
* Identify opportunities for developer self-service and engineering productivity improvement, using automation to remove repetitive manual activities and operational toil.

**Tribe Passport**

* Provide senior technical ownership for Tribe Passport, including solution architecture, engineering standards, code quality, release readiness, resilience and production stability.
* Evaluate engineering requirements and translate them into architectural designs, delivery plans, epics and technical work packages, identifying dependencies and trade-offs early.
* Lead the continued evolution of Tribe Passport across the UI, APIs and backend services, data ingestion, data stores and reporting capabilities using relevant Google Cloud services.
* Define scalable integration patterns with enterprise sources including GitHub/Bitbucket, Jira, ServiceNow, Waltz, SonarQube and organizational / workforce data.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to evolve Tribe Passport's capabilities around engineering productivity, DORA/flow metrics, software quality, SDLC controls, estate transparency and AI engineering adoption.
* Ensure Tribe Passport remains maintainable, supportable and aligned with appropriate security, data privacy, resilience and operational controls.
* Provide solution architecture leadership for complex technical initiatives, balancing security, resilience, observability, operability, cost, performance and regulatory requirements.
* Promote the responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools to improve developer productivity, automation and engineering quality, while protecting confidential information and validating generated outputs.

**Expected outcomes**

* Reusable cloud engineering and automation capabilities reduce manual effort, onboarding time and delivery lead time across multiple ATO teams and applications.
* Cloud provisioning, deployment and operational workflows become increasingly automated, repeatable, secure and self-service.
* Common Terraform, CI/CD and platform patterns achieve adoption across multiple workloads rather than remaining application-specific solutions.
* Tribe Passport remains a secure, resilient, maintainable and strategically relevant engineering-insight platform.
* Complex platform and application engineering problems move efficiently from architecture to production, with clear ownership and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Engineering controls covering security, OSS, deployment and operational readiness are embedded in engineering workflows rather than evidenced manually afterwards.
* Cloud and platform capabilities are designed for reuse and scale, reducing duplication and reliance on platform-specific implementation knowledge.
* Engineering teams benefit from clear technical standards, mentoring and reusable patterns that allow them to deliver more independently.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Extensive hands-on software and/or platform engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership of complex enterprise applications, cloud platforms or engineering capabilities.
* Strong development capability in Java and/or Python, with the ability to review code and designs, troubleshoot complex issues and contribute directly when required.
* Deep practical Google Cloud experience, ideally across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, IAM/service accounts, networking, load balancing and observability.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation experience, particularly with Terraform, including the development of reusable modules, templates and engineering patterns.
* Strong DevOps and platform engineering expertise across CI/CD technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins and TeamCity, including reusable pipeline and workflow design.
* Experience designing automation and self-service engineering capabilities for use across multiple applications and engineering teams.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
  
  
As a Vice President – AI Engineering & Prompt Architecture Lead in Predictive Science, you will own the technical vision and delivery for a team of prompt engineers and AI/ML model developers building intelligent document processing and data extraction solutions in the KYC/AML domain.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Architect agentic, multi-step AI workflows chaining classification → extraction → cross-validation → exception routing with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Debug and remediate complex prompt failures (context-window overflow, instruction drift in long chains, RAG retrieval poisoning, output/format instability).
* Design prompt/model evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy plus consistency, robustness, latency, cost-per-call, and hallucination rate.
* Operationalize prompt lifecycle management as production code: versioning, CI/CD prompt tests, A/B experiments, rollback, and audited change history.
* Guide model selection and optimization (prompting vs fine-tuning vs custom training) balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and data sensitivity.
* Design RAG architectures for financial documents: chunking, embeddings, vector store design, re-ranking, and context injection.
* Oversee fine-tuning/training workflows: dataset curation, annotation quality, training configurations, and generalization across document variants.
* Build and maintain evaluation infrastructure: benchmark/golden datasets, regression suites, and automated scoring to catch regressions pre-production.
* Define confidence calibration and escalation logic so systems estimate uncertainty and route low-confidence outputs to human reviewers with the right context.
* Partner with governance/model risk and data engineering: produce validator-ready documentation (explainability/auditability) and ensure robust, refreshed data/annotation/eval pipelines; drive AI-native development practices to improve velocity.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* 10+ years in NLP/AI/ML or computational linguistics, including 3+ years leading technical teams with direct reports.
* Hands-on LLM internals expertise: tokenization impacts, attention limits, context window management, and temperature/sampling trade-offs.
* Proven prompt architecture design/debugging: multi-turn chains, few-/many-shot, chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and constitutional AI.
* Strong RAG system design experience: embeddings trade-offs (e.g., ada/BGE/Cohere), chunking for semi-structured docs, hybrid retrieval (dense+sparse), and re-ranking.
* Fine-tuning experience: LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO, dataset curation, and evaluating tuned vs prompted performance.
* Python + ML engineering proficiency: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LlamaIndex (or equivalents), vector DBs (Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector), and API development.
* AI evaluation systems experience beyond F1: faithfulness, answer relevance, RAG context precision/recall, automated eval pipelines, and LLM-as-judge.
* Deep understanding of LLM failure modes: hallucinations, sycophancy, long-context instruction degradation, prompt-format sensitivity, and catastrophic forgetting.
* Structured output enforcement in production: JSON mode, function calling, constrained decoding, output parsers, and schema validation.
* Build-vs-buy/model selection track record: benchmarking foundation models (GPT-4/Claude/Llama/Mistral) against task requirements.
* Leadership under ambiguity: pragmatic trade-offs, rapid iteration as practices evolve, and strong communication with compliance, risk, and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Domain expertise in KYC/AML or financial document processing: entity extraction from registries, beneficial ownership structures, sanctions screening logic, adverse media classification.
* Experience designing autonomous AI agents: tool-use patterns, planning/reasoning loops, memory architectures, and safety guardrails for regulated environments.
* Knowledge of AI security/adversarial robustness: prompt injection defense, jailbreak detection, data poisoning awareness, and output monitoring for sensitive financial data.
* Experience with model distillation to produce smaller, faster models for cost-effective deployment.
* Familiarity with AI observability/monitoring: tracking prompt/model performance, drift detection, alerting, and health dashboards.
* Experience with multi-modal AI combining OCR, layout understanding, and LLM-based extraction for complex documents.
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in CS/NLP/ML or equivalent depth via publications, open-source, or production system design and Passion for talent development: growing engineers from junior prompt writers into senior AI system designers via structured mentorship.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and ensure timely implementation of actions arising from audits and regulatory reviews.
  

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

  

**Role requirements / Educational Qualifications /Certification / Experience:**

  

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, with relevant experience in banking or financial services, preferably across Liabilities, Banking Operations, Product Management and/or Demat/DP Operations
* 4–10 years of experience in DP operations, custody operations or capital markets operations within a bank, brokerage or financial institution, with hands-on experience of NSDL/

**Job Responsibilities :**

* Lead discussions with technology teams to agree and implement technical solutions for data quality remediation, including control automation/industrialization, monitoring, and evidence generation where appropriate.
* Discover and document end-to-end data lineage, tracing data from creation to consumption to support regulatory requirements such as BCBS 239 and internal standards for critical data elements and critical data flows.
* Partner with Markets operations, technology, and product control teams to establish and document data quality controls across critical data flows, including control points, thresholds, exception workflows, and ownership.
* Implement and champion Data Quality practices across the Commercial & Investment Bank, supporting firmwide regulatory and strategic objectives by defining and driving adoption of data quality standards, thresholds, remediation SLAs, and control expectations.
* Provide advisory services on high-profile data initiatives, leveraging project management and business analysis expertise to embed data quality, data lineage, and control requirements into strategic change (e.g., platform migrations, new product initiatives) from inception.
* Influence and guide stakeholders at all levels to drive adoption of data quality standards and best practices, and lead stakeholder forums to drive decisioning, escalations, and risk acceptance where required.
* Represent the Chief Data Office in cross-functional forums, contributing to the development of data management strategies and frameworks, including data quality strategy, issue management cadence, control documentation standards, data lineage documentation standards, and executive-level materials for senior stakeholders.
* Define and maintain management reporting (KPIs/KRIs) for data quality performance, including issue aging, defect recurrence, lineage completeness, and control coverage, to support senior decision-making.
* Apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate data quality investigations and delivery (e.g., drafting lineage/control documentation, synthesizing investigation findings, generating validation logic/test cases), ensuring appropriate data handling, human oversight, and adherence to firm policies.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Significant experience in financial services, with a background in operations, finance, program management, data analytics, or business analysis, and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional delivery across business and Technology stakeholders.
* Proven track record leading projects or business-as-usual initiatives focused on data quality, data lineage, control documentation, and metadata management, with clear accountability for outcomes, issue management cadence, and closure discipline.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and connect detailed analysis to broader business objectives, including translating complex investigations into executive-ready options and recommendations.
* Proficiency in manipulating and analyzing large data sets using Excel (pivots, formulas, charts) and other data tools to validate issues, quantify impact, and evidence remediation effectiveness.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across business and technology, including chairing working groups and contributing to senior steering forums.
* Self-starter with strong time management and organizational skills; adept at managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure while operating with strong risk discipline and attention to controls.
* Deep understanding of business practices and products within the Commercial & Investment Bank, with a focus on Markets.
* AI/LLM experience (required): demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools to improve productivity in data quality and data lineage documentation, analysis, and/or control design, with strong judgment around confidentiality, appropriate use, and required human review/validation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Expertise in data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and data control concepts, including standards and control frameworks.
* Experience in a Chief Data Office or Data Quality organization within an investment bank or large financial institution.
* Proficiency in querying databases or data stores for advanced data analysis.
* Skilled in producing executive-level PowerPoint presentations for senior audiences.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 and industry best practices in data management, and ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical data quality, data lineage, and control outcomes.

**ABOUT US**

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description-**

Citi operates through five major business divisions — Services, Markets, Banking and International, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking. Each of these generates complex financial data and transactions that require robust technology infrastructure. Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. Finance Technology lives within T&BE, making it a truly enterprise-wide function, delivering technology solutions for Finance, Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, and Treasury across all Citi businesses globally.

**Responsibilities**:

The Finance Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities. It is a Techno-functional hands-on role with experience building products that solve real and pressing problems in highly complex and regulated environments.

Key responsibility will be to define Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiatives.

With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills (using programming or AI tools), tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.

The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.

* Ownership of the Product backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.

* Participate in day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results

* Leada culture of innovation, “test and learn” experiments to create platform products that increase customer value. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.

* Defines and measures the KPIs for a platform product

* Is able to make trade-off decisions on multiple platform products in a portfolio

* Develop solution proposals, business cases, and budget requests

* Work in an agile environment, continuously reviewing the business needs, refining priorities, outlining milestones and deliverables, and identifying opportunities and risks

* Drive stakeholder alignment and iterative product delivery

* Lead business process redesign, operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management

* Manage cross-functional dependencies, regulatory and risk alignment, user adoption and change management.

* Work with Data: Data analysis to document business requirements at the right level, draw meaningful insights, and visualize conceptual and logical data models and flows. Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.

* Stay ahead of AI. This space moves fast. We need someone who follows it seriously, brings new ideas back to the team, and actively applies what they're learning to the products we build. If you've been experimenting with new models, new tooling, or new patterns, that's exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room.

* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

* Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information.

* Communicate like it matters. We're distributed across three continents. Clear, direct, proactive communication isn't a soft skill here. It's how the work gets done.

* Keep safety non-negotiable. We're building AI systems inside a global bank. Security, compliance, and AI safety aren't afterthoughts. You'll build with all of it in mind from the start. Report control gaps with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.

**Must-have skills:**

* Demonstrated experience in Product Management and/or Product Development discipline

* Strong understanding of Finance processes and data flows, record to report, Accounting, reconciliation, regulatory reporting and financial close process, with ability to interpret financial data. Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting
