**Job Summary**

* The PaPM CoE Delivery Head is responsible for leading the end-to-end PaPM Centre of Excellence (CoE), create a centralised capability to drive solution standardisation, architectural governance, delivery excellence, reusable assets, technical expertise across PaPM implementation. Partner with Technology and Finance stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable solutions, improve delivery efficiency, build organisational capabilities and maximise value derived from PaPM Investments.

**The PaPM CoE Delivery Head In India Will**
**Strategy & Leadership**

* Ensuring successful execution of the strategic roadmap, delivery of business use cases, platform governance, and operational excellence. The role is accountable for building and managing a high-performing team of PaPM specialists, establishing delivery standards, ensuring architecture compliance, and maximizing value realization from the PaPM platform across Finance, Treasury, Risk, Sustainability, and Performance Management functions. The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and senior leadership
* Define and execute the SAP PaPM CoE vision, operating model, and strategic roadmap.
* Drive adoption of SAP PaPM as the strategic platform for allocations, profitability analysis, scenario modelling, regulatory calculations, and performance management.
* Align PaPM initiatives with Finance Transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Analytics, and AI strategies.
* Establish long-term capability plans covering people, process, technology, and governance.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging SAP PaPM capabilities, AI enablement, and automation opportunities

**Delivery & Execution**

* Own the delivery portfolio and annual Book of Work (BoW) across all PaPM programs and initiatives.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects through design, build, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish predictable delivery governance, quality standards, and execution metrics.
* Drive prioritization of demand, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
* Ensure timely delivery within agreed scope, budget, quality, and risk parameters.

* Chair Solution Design Reviews and Architecture Governance forums.
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and non-functional requirements.

* Drive reusability and standardization across solution components.

* Serve as the senior point of contact for CFO, Finance Transformation, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and Operations stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships with senior business sponsors and journey owners.
* Present delivery status, risks, investment cases, and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums and steering committees.
* Manage vendor partnerships and oversee external delivery teams.

* Build and lead a multi-disciplinary team consisting of Solution Leads, Architects, Analysts, Modelers, and Platform Specialists.
* Define capability development strategy and certification pathways.
* Establish knowledge management, training programs, and communities of practice.
* Drive workforce planning and succession planning for niche PaPM skills.
* Foster innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across global teams.

**Platform Operations & Sustainability**

* Own platform health, stability, scalability, and performance.
* Ensure robust support, maintenance, release management, and incident management processes.
* Drive continuous optimization and technical debt reduction initiatives.
* Establish operational KPIs and service management standards.
* Ensure business continuity and resilience of critical PaPM processes

**Risk, Governance & Controls**

* Embed strong delivery, technology, and operational risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, security, and enterprise control requirements.
* Maintain transparent governance and reporting across all PaPM initiatives.
* Drive proactive identification and mitigation of delivery, platform, and resource risks

* Delivery of annual PaPM Book of Work.
* Time-to-market improvement for new use cases.
* Platform availability and stability.
* Stakeholder satisfaction scores.
* Budget adherence and cost efficiency.
* Adoption and utilization of PaPM capabilities.
* Audit and control compliance.
* Team capability and certification growth.
* Reuse of standard components and design patterns.

**Essential**
**Required Experience**

* 12+ years of experience in Finance Technology, Enterprise Applications, or Finance Transformation.
* 7+ years of SAP experience with significant exposure to SAP PaPM.
* Proven leadership experience managing global delivery teams and complex transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of:
* SAP PaPM
* SAP BW/BW4HANA
* SAP S/4HANA
* Finance and Controllership processes
* Profitability and Cost Management
* Transfer Pricing
* Allocations and Recharges
* Performance Management
* Experience managing senior business stakeholders and executive governance forums.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling Centres of Excellence.

**Preferred**

* Experience within Banking or Financial Services.
* Exposure to FP&A, Treasury, Risk, Regulatory Reporting, or Sustainability reporting.
* Experience leading vendor-delivered and hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled solution delivery and advanced analytics platforms.

Are you a results-oriented analytics leader with a strong ability to partner with business teams and translate complex operational problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions?
  
  
Join our Analytics & Information Management (AIM) organization as a
**Vice President – Wealth Operations Analytics**

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of

**Qualifications**

* 13–14 years of experience in Analytics, Data Science, or AI
* 3–6 years of people management experience
* Experience in Financial Services or Wealth Operations analytics preferred
* Mandatory: Proven experience delivering production-grade Generative AI and/or Agentic AI solutions, including problem framing, model/application design, and measurable business impact realization
* Experience working with enterprise constraints such as data privacy, latency, and model governance in AI deployments

**Industry & Functional Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of operations analytics and process optimization
* Exposure to Wealth Management domains such as client lifecycle, KYC, servicing, or trade lifecycle preferred

**Analytical & Technical Skills**

* Strong problem structuring and hypothesis-driven analysis
* Experience in statistical techniques, segmentation, and predictive analytics
* Proficiency in SQL and Python (or R/SAS)
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI

**AI & Data Skills (Critical)**

* Hands-on experience with:

+ Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-based frameworks)
+ Agentic AI (multi-step workflows, orchestration frameworks)

* Understanding of AI/ML lifecycle, APIs, and deployment architectures
* Experience driving AI-led automation and transformation initiatives

**Leadership & Professional Skills**

* Exceptional ability to understand business problems and translate them into analytics and AI solutions
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Excellent communication and storytelling ability
* Proven ability to operate in a global, matrixed organization
* High ownership mindset with strong execution focus

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science)
* Master’s degree (MBA/MS) preferred

**Success Metrics**

* Adoption of analytics and AI solutions within Wealth Operations workflows
* Stakeholder satisfaction and influence
* Team capability uplift, particularly in Generative AI and advanced analytics
* Quality, timeliness, and scalability of delivery

**Why This Role Matters**
This role is critical in transforming Wealth Operations into an AI-enabled, insight-driven function. You will directly influence how business problems are solved using data, analytics, and next-generation AI, driving improvements in efficiency, scalability, and client experience.
  
  
**This role provides a unique opportunity to shape the adoption of AI within Wealth Operations while working closely with global stakeholders on high-impact transformation initiatives.**

jobs.title: Quantitative Analytics Director
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Quantitative Analytics Director .
  
  
The role is within the Model Risk Management (MRM) group and will operate in a dual role:
  
  

* Team Oversight: To oversee teams of validators responsible for model risk management of Capital, Liquidity, Allowance & Planning (CLAP) models.
* Model Risk Officer (MRO): To serve as the Model Risk Officer for Business Planning models in the bank.

Model Risk Management: MRM is responsible for validating and monitoring models, independently overseeing the management of model risk exposures across the enterprise, including governing, monitoring, and reporting on aggregate model risk exposures. This oversight extends to all phases of a model’s life cycle, including model identification, development, validation, implementation, resolution of model risk findings, model usage, performance monitoring, documentation, and retirement. The model inventory of the bank is partitioned into groups each headed by a Group Model Risk Officer (GMRO), who is assisted by a team of Model Risk Officers each managing a subgroup of models with the help of model validation teams located in the US and in India.
  
  
Capital, Liquidity, Allowance & Planning: Within MRM, the CLAP group is headed by the CLAP GMRO assisted by MROs for model subgroups including models from Retail Credit, Commercial Credit, Mortgages, Wealth & Investment Management, Treasury, Finance and Business Planning. In the CLAP Oversight capacity, the candidate will head the India CLAP team, working with multiple downstream managers on MRM agenda, GMRO priorities, strategic initiatives and personnel matters.
  
  
Business Planning team: This team within CLAP oversees model risk in business planning models across all lines of business to make decisions around staffing, capacity planning, revenue and expense forecasting, optimization of operations, inventory management, recovery resolution and planning. The responsibilities of this team include end-to-end model risk management over the entire model lifecycle adhering to guidance and goals set by the CLAP GMRO and MRM policies and procedures. As MRO, the candidate will have the functional responsibility of managing model risk across all business planning models, aided by a team of model validators covering this area.
  
  
This highly visible position requires strong risk management and technical expertise, along with the ability to build strategic partnerships across the enterprise. Effective communication with technical staff, senior management, auditors, and regulators is crucial. The role operates in a fast-paced environment, necessitating multitasking and meeting strict deadlines to ensure policy adherence and effective model risk management.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage and develop teams responsible for the creation, implementation and validation of complex financial and statistical models
* Analyze and manage risks to enable decision making for businesses for staffing, planning, forecasting or other functional areas related to business operations
* Provide expert opinion on models for business operations and support overall business process and risk management
* Perform various compliance requirements with corporate and regulatory reporting, involving finance and capitalization requirements
* Be an authority on model risk policies and procedures, and enforce adherence to them
* Determine scope and prioritization of work
* Perform key input in the development of strategy, policies, procedures, and organizational controls
* Manage multiple teams of highly skilled quantitative analysts or managers
* Interface with internal and external audit or regulators
* Manage complex organizations that develop predictive models including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Lead groups responsible for creation, implementation, validation, and ongoing maintenance
* Analyze models, manage markets, credit, counterparty, and operational risks

* Identify opportunities and strategies for analytics and data science through experienced managers and business strategies

The group is also tasked with managing model risk governance, ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and regulations. Mizuho seeks a highly motivated individual to serve as a Director, responsible for building and leading Model Risk team at the Mizuho Pune office. The role reports locally to the Mizuho Pune Head of Risk and globally to the Head of Model Risk Management within America’s Risk Management department.

* Establish and lead the Model Risk capability in Mizuho Pune, including operating model, processes and ways of working.
* Build and lead a high-performing Pune Model Risk team and help evolve Mizuho Pune into an active risk-management hub.
* Act as the senior Model Risk point of contact for the Pune site, ensuring effective connectivity with MUSO and global Model Risk teams.
* Manage a team of validation specialists, focusing on Pricing/Valuation models for Equity and Fixed Income Derivatives, XVA and other related models, providing guidance as necessary to ensure that the most robust independent review and challenge is possible
* Train and develop junior team members focusing on overlapping areas of expertise within the team, independence of view, and vocal challenge

* Assist in maintaining a strong model governance framework, working with management and model owners to ensure maximum alignment with regulatory and policy requirements

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience Qualifications:**

* 18-20+ years of experience in financial services with specific experience in Model Risk
* Solid understanding of risk management concepts
* Working knowledge of SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 guidance on model risk management
* Strong management skills with experience in managing quants while maintaining strong relationships with management and business stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience in responding to audit and regulatory requests
* Impeccable attention to detail and a high standard of polish with regards to documentation and presentation materials

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

jobs.description:

At Wells Fargo, a Securities Operations Manager manages and develops a team responsible for securities operations activities and related transaction processing. You will oversee resources, operational delivery, processes, and controls to achieve service, quality, risk, compliance, and business objectives.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage and develop a team of individual contributors performing low to moderately complex securities operations work
* Make decisions regarding resources, objectives, and operations to meet service, quality, risk, and compliance commitments
* Identify and recommend process improvements and risk control development within the scope of responsibility
* Interpret and may develop policies and procedures for low to moderately complex functions
* Collaborate with and influence professionals and managers and coordinate with business, risk, compliance, and technology partners
* Manage people and financial resources, mentor direct reports, and assist in hiring talent
* Lead end-to-end CDR operations, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of teller cash differences.
* Manage team performance, productivity, quality, capacity planning, and inventory management.
* Maintain strong operational controls, compliance adherence, and audit readiness.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex cases, risk events, and stakeholder concerns.
* Drive employee engagement, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.

* Identify and implement process improvement and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

* 5+ years of securities operations experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience using analytics and data analysis to identify trends, investigate exceptions, and support operational decisions
* Knowledge of compliance requirements and risk controls applicable to securities transaction processing and operational workflows
* Ability to apply customer insights, customer support operations, and product knowledge to improve service and resolve issues
* Experience managing process delivery and transaction management activities across time-sensitive operational work

This role provides critical leadership and oversight for the CDR function, ensuring operational performance, risk management, compliance adherence, and stakeholder support. jobs.title: Associate Director - Private Markets Operations
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who we are**
With over $1.58 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the world’s leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the world’s leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Your Team**
Team of circa 40 individuals, dedicated to supporting Private Market Operations globally. The team covers a very wide range of activities, from UW and performance measurement to Investors reporting, including data governance and management.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Lead and manage multiple teams within our Private Market Operations function in Hyderabad (Performance, Research, Operations, Marketing, UW, etc).
* This role is pivotal in driving strategic direction, operational excellence, and talent development across the business.
* The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, deep domain expertise, and a collaborative mindset to support our global growth and transformation agenda.

**Strategic Leadership & Execution**

* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for HYD Private Market Operations in alignment with global objectives.
* Drive operational efficiency, scalability, and innovation across teams and processes.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders across regions to ensure alignment and delivery of key initiatives.

**Team & People Management**

* Lead and mentor multiple teams across operational functions, fostering a high-performance culture.
* Oversee headcount planning, recruitment, onboarding, and career development strategies.
* Promote diversity, inclusion, and employee engagement across the Hyderabad office.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure timely and accurate execution of private market transactions, reporting, and client servicing.
* Implement and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and quality control measures to maintain service excellence.
* Identify and mitigate operational risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal standards.

**Transformation & Change Management**

* Champion process improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Lead change management efforts to support new systems, workflows, and organizational changes.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders
* Represent Hyderabad operations in global forums and contribute to cross-functional projects.

**The Experience You Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in financial services, with a strong background in private markets or asset management operations in an international environment.
* Proven track record in managing large teams and complex operational environments.
* Strong understanding of real estate and fund structures.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with global delivery models and working in a matrixed organization is preferred.
* Perfectly fluent in English

**Academic Requirements**
Master’s degree or an equivalent certificate in Finance, Accounting, Management, or Mathematics.
  
  
**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
Yes
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).

As a Conduct Risk Operations manager within the Compliance Conduct and Operational Risk organization, you will manage a Risk operations team to ensure that our customers, employees, and lines of business are in adherence with firm standards and required regulations. Your role requires a high level of collaboration across the global Advisory, Technology, LOB, Control and Operations teams. jobs.title: Investor Services Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Job Description**
As Investor Services India Lead you lead Investor Services in India. You build the team, bring each specialist team live with the right controls in place, and run India to our global service levels as part of one team across India, Europe, Asia and the US.
  
  
You are the senior Investor Services voice in India and a partner to Investor Services leaders in other locations, Compliance and our transformation programme.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Leading Investor Services India**

* Own performance of every India specialist team against our service levels, quality measures and capacity targets, and report monthly.
* Plan capacity and growth with the Regional Head and partner hubs, including cover when other hubs are stretched.

**Building and launching**

* Recruit, onboard and assess the India team.
* Bring each specialist team live once the systems, routing and reporting it needs are in place.
* Run interim arrangements and parallel running until then; nothing is switched off before its replacement works.

**Controls and risk**

* Run India to a high-risk control standard: separation of duties, independent quality checks in another hub, documented sign-off and a complete audit trail.
* Own business continuity for India: take over live cases within 24 hours when needed, and test it twice a year.
* Lead India's part in audits and regulatory reviews, and close findings on time.

**Working as one global team**

* Run handovers with hubs in Europe and Asia so cases keep moving around the clock.
* Route work between hubs so every team member can build the experience they need.
* Make sure escalations follow the right compliance route for each country.

**People and culture**

* Lead the India team and build a culture of quality, ownership and growth.
* Own engagement, retention and succession for Investor Services India.

**Transformation**

* Represent India in the design of our end-to-end KYC process, the Fenergo roadmap and the wider Investor Services programme.
* Drive improvements that remove manual handoffs and shorten the time investors wait.

**How You Grow**
Our people build their careers by moving through ten KYC specialisms every 6–12 months, each ending with a skills assessment and a certification. Progression is by competency, not tenure, and experienced hires are assessed on joining and start at the level they have earned.
  
  
The role is a platform for wider regional or global Investor Services leadership.
  
  
**What You Bring**
Your CV needs to show at least 10 years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5 or more years leading multi-team operations; applications without this won't be taken forward.
  
  

* 10+ years in KYC, AML or CDD operations, including 5+ years leading multi-team operations in financial services.
* Experience building and scaling a team in India for global stakeholders.
* A strong control mindset: audits, regulatory reviews and operational risk.
* Data-driven management of service levels, quality and capacity.
* Excellent senior stakeholder management across Europe, Asia and the US.

**Nice To Have**

* Fund administration, transfer agency or private markets experience.
* Experience of technology-led operations change, ideally with Fenergo.
* ACAMS, ICA diploma or equivalent.
* Experience of a global capability centre or round-the-clock operating model.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. **About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

This position functions as regional general counsel for all CIBC India business activities, principally supporting CIBC India as a global delivery centre servicing CIBC legal entities and business units globally. The overall purpose of the role is to provide leadership and advice regarding legal matters, with the objective of helping business leaders achieve business goals in a manner consistent with sound risk management. The Head of Legal, India negotiates agreements, manages litigation, and participates as the Legal representative on applicable regional governance committees.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Value Added Partner:**

* Provide legal advice in relation to business plans and help to ensure proper implementation of those plans, consistent with legal and any applicable regulatory requirements.
* Act as Whole-Time Company Secretary for CIBC India.
* Active member of CIBC India regional senior management team and any related committees.
* Fulfill commitments embodied in the Legal Department mandate in relation to CIBC India.



**Transaction and Litigation Support:**

* Provide legal advice and related governance to support CIBC India’s business activities, including with respect to CIBC India’s employment law and intellectual property matters and regulatory changes.
* Negotiate CIBC's agreements India, either directly or through external counsel acting under your oversight.
* Manage CIBC's litigation in India and keep global Legal team and regional senior management apprised of significant developments and deadlines. Often such litigation involves complex cross border Issues requiring coordination and management among internal business and infrastructure groups, law firms, witnesses and courts in different jurisdictions and time zones.

**Internal and External Business Development/Client Service:**

* Monitor legal changes in the relevant jurisdictions to assess the impact on relevant lines of business, and identify new business opportunities and/or regulatory risks.

**Risk Management:**

* Identify legal risks, and significant incidents of non-compliance, and escalate these to global Legal team and senior management of India (as relevant), ensuring such risks are properly understood. Where possible, propose appropriate risk mitigation.
* Conduct quarterly Board Meetings in India (in person or virtually from India) and any ad hoc or additional Board meetings as necessary.
* Prepare and maintain statutory registers, minutes, resolutions, notices, and agendas.
* Support information requests relating to Legal’s accountabilities from internal and external auditors.
* Ensure compliance with up to 325 event-based activities and ~66 regular compliance requirements under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Advise on legal matters pertaining to corporate governance, corporate actions, drafting, and regulatory filings.
* Liaise with regulatory bodies and ensure effective communication and resolution of statutory matters.

**Governance and Reporting:**

* Prepare and present Legal reporting to senior management and Board in India and Legal global management.
* Partner with Legal’s Transformation & Operational Resilience team (as the 1B function for Legal) to complete attestation and certification of controls and deficiencies.

**Continuous Learning and Professional Development:**

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry trends relating to CIBC India’s business activities.
* Pursue relevant training, certifications, and development opportunities.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Collaborate with teams in India and globally to support corporate governance and legal requirements.
* Participate in or lead special projects related to legal, corporate governance, and process improvement.
* Reports to Head of CIBC India.
* [Dotted line to Head of Legal, Asia Pacific (Capital Markets – US, UK, Asia).]

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Ambiguity due to rapidly changing regulatory environment.
* Ability to maintain current knowledge of evolving regulations.
* Leadership in corporate governance and legal issues.
* Direct Operating Expenses: not applicable.

**Experience: 15+ years:**

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

* Qualified Company Secretary in India (ICSI Membership required).
* University degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Law, or related field (MBA, M.Com, LLB, B.Com), with a degree in law and admission to practice as an Advocate preferred.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in secretarial, legal, and corporate governance.
* Extensive knowledge of Companies Act, 2013, corporate governance, and statutory compliance.
* Strong understanding of Indian legal and regulatory requirements applicable to a global capability centre, in particular relating to employment law and intellectual property.
* Previous experience in a global delivery centre or a large international organization preferred.
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills (oral, written, presentation

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Brings enthusiasm to the team.

* Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them.

* Observes behaviours and models self after others.

* Leads by example by performing at high levels.

**Focus on Results**

**Drives for Results**

* Works hard to achieve objectives.

* Stays focused on key commitments.

* Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing.

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.

**Critical Experiences**

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.

========================

Req ID: 124671

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

  

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

  

We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. As a **Talent & Culture Analyst**, you will be accountable for the accurate, timely and well-controlled delivery of Talent & Culture operational processes across the full employee lifecycle in India branch. This role is suited to a high-performing HR professional who can operate at pace, manage competing priorities, and deliver with discipline in a regulated, multinational banking environment. Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Full-time

**Role Location:** Mumbai, India

* Deliver seamless Talent & Culture operations across the employee lifecycle, including recruitment support, benefits, employee data management, regulatory reporting and statutory compliance.

* Anchoring and ensuring delivery of
* + all statutory and regulatory HR compliance obligations for all branch locations (Mumbai, Gurgaon, Bengaluru & GIFT City)

* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve processes, enhancing efficiency, quality and stakeholder experience.
* Champion ANZ's values while contributing to a culture of high performance, inclusion, accountability and continuous improvement.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Proven experience in HR function, ideally within a multinational, regulated, or professional services environment.
* A bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Law, Commerce or a related discipline. HR qualifications, knowledge of India employment practices, and experience in banking, financial services or another regulated industry will be advantageous.
* Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate, high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive, self-driven, and highly organised, with excellent planning, execution and follow-through skills.
* Strong stakeholder management capability, with experience partnering with leaders, regional teams, service hubs and external providers.
* Solid understanding of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, benefits, employee data management and offboarding.

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. New Business Development & Lead Generation**

* Follow up on assigned leads and arrange meetings with prospective B2B clients across the assigned territory / zone in a timely and structured manner.

**2. Product Demonstrations & Pre-Sales Engagement**

* Develop thorough, in-depth functional knowledge of all assigned APT products – for both sales conversations and post-sale client advisory.
* Conduct structured, confident product demonstrations and presentations for prospective clients – positioning APT's solutions as the most relevant fit for the client's specific needs.
* Prepare supporting documentation – quotations, product notes, and proposal decks – to move deals forward efficiently and professionally.
* Handle commercial negotiations within approved parameters and close business deals – ensuring full documentation is handed over accurately to the CS and Billing teams.
* Consistently work towards and surpass assigned quarterly and annual new business targets.

**3. Client Relationship Management & Account Retention**

* Develop long-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders across assigned existing client accounts – positioning yourself as a reliable, knowledgeable, and responsive point of contact.
* Schedule and conduct regular client meetings and structured check-ins – monitoring satisfaction levels, addressing concerns proactively, and reinforcing the value of APT's products and services.
* Create and execute quarterly client engagement plans – structured around key accounts, upcoming renewals, and product awareness or training needs.
* Act as the first point of contact for client complaints and escalations – owning the resolution process and coordinating internally to ensure prompt, professional closure.
* Proactively seek and document client feedback and share structured insights with the concerned teams.

**4. AMC & Subscription Renewal Management**

* Take full ownership of AMC and subscription renewals for all assigned client accounts – tracking renewal timelines, initiating engagement well in advance, and ensuring zero unplanned churn.
* Prepare, present, and negotiate renewal proposals and commercial quotes with clients – handling negotiations confidently and finalizing agreements.
* Identify and actively pursue **upsell and cross-sell opportunities** within the existing client base – introducing clients to additional APT products or service tiers that genuinely address their evolving needs.
* Maintain accurate, current records of all renewals, client interactions, and commercial discussions in the CRM system.

**5. Client Training & Product Awareness**

* Conduct product training sessions and awareness programs for assigned clients – helping them maximize adoption, utilization, and value from APT's products and services.
* Proactively advise clients on product updates, new features, and best practices that could benefit their organization.
* Prepare client-facing training documentation, user guides, and awareness materials where required.

**6. Market Intelligence & Internal Collaboration**

* Track competitor activity, market trends, and regulatory developments – and share structured insights with the teams at defined intervals.
* Provide field intelligence to the concerned team(s) to support product positioning, campaigns, and collateral development.
* Collaborate proactively with the Product Delivery, Product Development, and Marketing teams to address client needs and ensure a seamless client experience across the entire lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate and current records of all client interactions, deal stages, renewal timelines, and pipeline activity in the CRM system.
* Provide regular, structured updates to the Reporting Head on new business pipeline, renewal status, client health, and market observations.

**Qualification / Skill-sets**

* Graduates / Professional Degree-holders / Post-Graduates desirous of a career spanning both Business Development / Sales and Client Relationship Management in the IT Software Solutions / Services space.
* 2-3 years of overall experience. Freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and client orientation are actively encouraged to apply.
* Pleasing personality with excellent oral and written communication skills – a non-negotiable prerequisite for this client-facing role.
* Sound presentation creation and delivery skills – including the ability to engage confidently with senior institutional stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving aptitude – with the clarity and composure to understand client issues and find structured, practical resolutions.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities – new business conversations, active renewals, client relationships, and internal coordination – without losing detail or urgency.
* Character traits of patience, resilience, and adaptability – essential for navigating long sales cycles while simultaneously sustaining trusted client relationships.
* Willingness and enthusiasm to extensively travel across assigned territory *(within the city and PAN India, by any means of transport)* – and a genuine passion for daily client interaction.
* Proficiency in MS Office – particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
* Keen desire for collaboration and interaction with internal cross-functional teams.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill-sets**

* Prior experience of 2 years in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Client Relationship Management – ideally in IT Software Solutions / Services, with a demonstrable track record.
* Prior exposure to the BFSI sector – including banks, NBFCs, cooperative institutions, mutual fund houses, insurance companies, or financial training institutions – in a sales or relationship management capacity.

* Working knowledge of CRM software for pipeline management, renewal tracking, and client interaction records and exposure to AMC, subscription-based, or SaaS commercial models and the associated renewal and upsell processes.

**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.

jobs.title: Head of Treasury
jobs.description:
**Head of Treasury - Investment Holding Group**

**The Opportunity**

I am working with a well-established investment holding group in the UAE that is looking to appoint a Head of Treasury. The business has a significant portfolio of investments across multiple sectors and international markets.

As the group continues to grow and diversify, it is looking for someone to take ownership of its treasury function, develop its funding strategy and improve how cash, liquidity and financial risk are managed across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on leadership role with direct exposure to senior management and shareholders. The successful candidate will be expected to bring ideas, challenge existing processes and build a treasury function that can support the group's future investment activity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage the group's treasury strategy, including liquidity planning, funding and capital allocation.
* Advise senior management on the investment of surplus cash, balancing returns, liquidity requirements and financial risk.
* Manage relationships with UAE and international banks, negotiating funding facilities, credit lines, guarantees and deposit arrangements.
* Lead debt financing, refinancing and capital structure initiatives across group entities.
* Oversee FX and interest-rate exposure, including the use of appropriate hedging instruments.
* Lead the implementation and development of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), banking integrations and reporting automation.
* Establish treasury policies, controls and governance frameworks across the group.
* Improve cash visibility and forecasting across subsidiaries, investments and international operations.
* Work closely with investment and finance teams to understand upcoming transactions, funding requirements and capital commitments.
* Provide regular treasury reporting and recommendations to senior management and shareholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve banking terms, reduce financing costs and generate better returns on available cash.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 12–18+ years of experience across corporate treasury, group treasury or corporate finance, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Background within an investment holding company, family office, conglomerate, real estate investment group or similarly complex organisation.
* Strong experience managing sizeable cash, debt or investment portfolios.
* Proven experience negotiating directly with banks on financing facilities, refinancing, guarantees and other treasury products.
* Good understanding of treasury investments, capital allocation, FX and interest-rate risk management.
* Experience implementing or leading TMS projects, treasury automation and process improvements.
* Strong UAE banking relationships and knowledge of the regional financial market.
* Comfortable operating in a lean team, taking ownership and working directly with senior stakeholders.
* CTP, ACT, CFA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent qualifications would be advantageous.

**The Opportunity Offers**

* A senior role with responsibility for developing the group's treasury function.
* Direct involvement in funding decisions, capital allocation and treasury strategy.
* Exposure to a diversified portfolio of investments across the UAE and international markets.
* The opportunity to lead treasury systems implementation and improve existing processes.
* Regular interaction with senior management and shareholders.

Applications will be treated confidentially. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

jobs.title: Head of M&A
jobs.description:
**Head of M&A**

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.
* Trusted adviser: build senior relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, and position the bank beyond its traditional financing role as an adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and strategy.
* M&A execution: lead sell-side and buy-side transactions end to end. This covers transaction strategy, valuation, process design, marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and closing.
* Equity story and positioning: develop compelling equity and investment narratives for clients and assets, combining rigorous financial analysis with a clear view of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation.
* Buyer and investor access: identify, approach and build credibility with strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors, both in the region and internationally.
* Private capital: originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.
* A demonstrable track record of executing complex sell-side and buy-side transactions.
* Proven origination capability, with the ability to find opportunities, win mandates and build a business, not only execute.
* Credibility and executive presence with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs, boards and sophisticated investors, plus experience handling critical negotiations with the C-suite, financial sponsors and other stakeholders in an M&A process.

**Knowledge and skills**

M&A technical and execution expertise; valuation and financial analysis; equity story development and investment positioning; origination and business development; senior client and board-level relationship management; negotiation; process design and deal management; private capital and growth equity structuring; investor and buyer coverage; commercial judgement; cross-functional collaboration; an entrepreneurial, franchise-building mindset.
