jobs.title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.title: Officer, Virtual Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just right for you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

* DBS India Consumer Banking Group including digibank (Retail Banking) and Treasures (Wealth Segment) serves over 2.6 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services.
* It is a business that focuses on quality customer acquisition through multiple acquisition channels, customer-centric value propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.
* DBS has been at the forefront of adapting and incorporating rapid changes in technology to understand and serve customer needs better. Virtual Relationship Managers are a step in that direction.
* Thus Treasures Virtual Relationship Manager is a key role within the Consumer Banking Group Business that is responsible for engaging with clients across the geographies in India and Globally, greatly enhancing the client experience through the effective use of technology.
* A high level of customer-centricity, interpersonal relationships complemented by “multi-channel” approach to relationship management via online and digi app are critical to succeed in this role.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire clients through e-boarding of the provided leads and nurture the relationship for AUM build up in a steady manner.
* Establish the Virtual Relationship Channel as a major revenue contributor through effective engagement with clients via multiple communication channels
* Ensure right balance of the product mix and balance NTB (New to Bank NR customers) with increased penetration of existing customers to deepen the wallet share.
* Drive and deliver a radical improvement in customer satisfaction scores through timely engagement and redressal of client enquiries.
* Ensure highest levels of customer satisfaction. Interact with new customers to detail & explain all features & functions of products & assist in on boarding of new clients.
* Empower DBS IN clients embrace the value delivery channels to improve transaction efficiency and effectiveness

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* Quality engagement with Emerging Affluent and Treasures clients to retain and developing sustainable relationships
* Ensure effective and efficient on-boarding, client coverage and client economics.
* Coordinate and drive timely investment and insurance portfolio reviews partnering with Investment / Insurance / Wealth specialists in Cluster locations.
* Establish relationships with the client’s basis opportunities identified by key acquiringchannels such as SME / CEP/IBG/ DBS Experience Centers or influencers for on-boarding the clients and ensure qualification as Treasures basis the stipulated criteria.
* Ensure service delivery by ensuring appropriate workflows and processes including digital on-boarding, upgrades, Scan / E-mail based wealth transactions, doorstep banking services, digital and remote account maintenance (Re-KYC / Risk Reviews) etc.
* Work closely with Cluster locations, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure that customer instructions are executed correctly and in a timely manner
* Improving customer experience by collating customer feedback, identifying areas to improve such as operational, administrative, processes and competitiveness of products and services
* Maintaining an awareness of relevant products and services available so as to provide the best solutions for clients as per their identified needs and aspirations
* Supporting process and product improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback on service and product offering and ensuring compliance with internal audit and regulatory requirements and quality assurance
* Adhere to DBS India and Group standards on code of conduct and controls in line with bank values and expectations

**Requirements:**

* Servicing high net worth clients at a financial institution / KPO
* While technical competence is not essential, ability to handle client requests via e-channels and versatility with digital tools would be beneficial.
* Good knowledge of wealth management products, both investment and insurance
* Customer oriented and able to capture customer financial needs
* Holder of relevant insurance, investment certification requirements (AMFI / IRDAI Composite license) would be an advantage
* Good command of spoken English and Hindi. Fluency in other regional languages (Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu etc.) would be an advantage.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline. Postgraduation in marketing or finance or banking would be desirable

**Core Competencies**

* Selling and team influencing skills to grow customer numbers and customer product uptake
* People Management
* Communication Skills
* Drive for Action
* Ability to work in an ambiguous environment
* Excellent understanding of the Bank’s Strategy and ability to interpret this and execute effectively to grow customer wallet share
* Proven track record in execution of sales or marketing strategy that resulted in business growth

Work Relationship
  
  

* Ensuring remote coverage and engagement of customers along with Branch teams for support.
* Close interaction with Channels / Segments and Clusters to ensure consistent delivery of service and business objectives.

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviours are:
  
  

* Demonstrate Business Performance through PRIDE 2.0 Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity.

Pune-DBIL

Product Sales

Regular

jobs.title: Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth
jobs.description:
**Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

**Location:**
Pune (Work from Office)

**Reporting To:**
COO / Managing Director

**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-focused business leader who combines the mindset of a hunter with the maturity of a strategic account leader. This role will be responsible for driving strategic customer acquisition, expanding existing accounts, managing key customer relationships, leading large delivery teams, and owning the P&L of assigned business units.

The ideal candidate has progressed from individual contributor sales roles into leadership positions and has successfully acquired new customers, built and expanded strategic accounts, developed high-performing teams, and delivered measurable revenue outcomes within IT Services, Technology Services, BPO, Demand Generation, Marketing Services, or Digital Services organizations.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in startups and mid-sized organizations. Profiles from large organizations are not preferred.

This is a leadership position offering significant autonomy, influence, and growth opportunities. The individual will actively contribute to the company's business strategy, customer acquisition roadmap, and future expansion plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

Drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across assigned business units.

Identify, prospect, and convert high-value business opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

Develop and execute strategic sales plans to penetrate new markets and acquire key accounts.

Identify growth opportunities within existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, and service expansion.

Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders and decision-makers.

Develop account plans, revenue forecasts, and customer expansion roadmaps.

Drive customer retention, renewals, and long-term account profitability.

Own business unit P&L and profitability targets.

**2. Strategic Account Management**

Act as the primary relationship owner for strategic customer accounts.

Build strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers across customer organizations.

Ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term partnership growth.

Lead quarterly and annual business reviews with customers.

Proactively manage customer expectations, escalations, and relationship risks.

Identify opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and maximize account value.

**3. Operational Leadership**

Serve as the bridge between customers and internal execution teams.

Lead and mentor teams comprising Program Managers, Assistant Program Managers, Team Leads, and Business Development Specialists.

Ensure delivery excellence and achievement of customer SLAs, KPIs, and business outcomes.

Build scalable operational processes, governance models, and best practices.

Drive productivity, quality improvements, and operational efficiency initiatives.

Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**4. Business Strategy & Governance**

Conduct regular SWOT analysis of operations, customers, competitors, and market opportunities.

Present monthly and quarterly business reviews, revenue forecasts, strategic plans, and performance achievements.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Digital, and Delivery teams to improve customer outcomes and accelerate business growth.

Monitor market trends and identify new business opportunities aligned with the company's service offerings.

Contribute actively to the company's strategic planning, revenue expansion, and future growth initiatives.

**Compensation**

**Salary will be no bar for the right candidate**
, based on relevant experience, leadership capabilities.

jobs.description:
**Description**
**About WTW**
Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.
  
  
We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance.
  
  
Together, we unlock potential.
  
  
**About The Team**
**The Role**

Siemens Financial Services India is a subsidiary of Siemens AG and has been operating in India for approximately 15 years. jobs.title: Client Analytics Business Partner
jobs.description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

jobs.title: Associate Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**
**Eligibility & Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience
* AMFI IRDA NISM XXI A (PMS Certification) and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) or equivalent certification or equivalent demonstrable experience where required by the market.

**Additional Information**
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East and Pakistan. The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.

**Portfolio Strategy And Financial Performance**

* Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

**Origination And Trusted-adviser Coverage**

* Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Sustainable And Innovative Finance**

* Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

**Risk, Compliance And Portfolio Stewardship**

* Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

**Market Insight And Franchise Development**

* Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
* Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
* Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.

**Motivations**

* Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.
* Origination and innovation: Motivated by creating commercially sound, differentiated solutions across financing, markets, transaction banking and sustainable finance.
* International collaboration: Thrives in a cross-border environment that requires judgement, resilience, teamwork and effective mobilisation of the Bank’s network.

**Key Experiences, Qualifications And Languages**

* 10+ years of relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline preferred.
* Strong knowledge of credit, AML, CDD, conduct and regulatory requirements. Any market-specific licence required to undertake banking business must be maintained.

* Arabic or other relevant regional language capability is advantageous.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description:
The Job in short
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across the Middle East You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase’s Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer’s business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase’s product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks’ business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.
  
  
**How About You**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management in KSA, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.
* Technical Acumen: Previous experience in roles requiring technical understanding, particularly in customer success management within a software company.
* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.
* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.
* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase’s partner network.
* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer’s market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.
* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end architecture for complex, multi-tiered systems, from requirements through implementation and production support.
* Lead the transformation of traditional monolithic applications into modern, loosely coupled, microservices-based architectures.

* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, security, and DevOps teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for performance, scalability, and compliance.
* Conduct system and process analysis to identify architectural gaps and opportunities for automation and performance improvement.
* Evaluate and recommend data storage strategies across RDBMS, NoSQL, and legacy/emerging database technologies.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering teams and non-technical/business stakeholders, clearly communicating architectural trade-offs and decisions.
* Ensure solutions adhere to banking-industry regulatory, security, and data-privacy requirements (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOX, GLBA, and internal risk/compliance frameworks).
* Contribute to architecture governance, design reviews, and the definition of reusable patterns and standards across the GCC.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12–15 years of experience in web/software development, with progressively increasing responsibility in solutions or enterprise architecture.
* Proven, hands-on experience with the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-tiered software systems.
* Strong foundation across multiple IT disciplines, with demonstrated understanding of core architectural concepts and patterns (e.g., SOA, event-driven, microservices, domain-driven design).
* Experience conducting system and process analysis to inform architectural decisions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions with both technical and non-technical/business stakeholders.
* Solid experience working with data and database management systems, including both legacy and modern/emerging database technologies.
* Experience with RDBMS required; hands-on experience with NoSQL is required.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building highly available, customer-facing applications in a global delivery/shared-services (GCC) model.
* Experience designing and building cloud-native applications and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
* Demonstrated experience designing highly available, resilient architectures, including automation and performance-optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience transforming monolithic architectures into modern, decoupled microservices-based systems.
* Working experience in at least two to three of the following domains: Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, Application Development, Database Technologies, or Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or foreign equivalent); equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

**Desired / Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the banking or financial services domain, including an understanding of consumer and custodial banking operations and experience handling sensitive financial data.

* Working knowledge of multiple programming languages and at least one modern front-end framework (Angular, React, or Vue), such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang, C, or C++.

* Experience working in Agile/SAFe delivery environments across distributed, global teams and time zones.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

* Design and document end-to-end data flows, Data mapping documents, and data lineage to trace wire payments attributes from source in to central data repository.

* Review test scenarios, test cases, test results, and other testing artefacts prior to and during test execution phases to ensure coverage and quality.
* Participate in SIT and UAT support activities, including validation of business scenarios and analysis of defects and gaps.
* Contribute to defect triage discussions and recommend workarounds to support Operations teams in payment processing and settlement activities.
* Perform data analysis using SQL to validate requirements, investigate issues, and support testing activities.

**Compliance and Risk Management:**

* Incorporate regulatory, operational, and control considerations into analysis and solution definition for payments initiatives.
* Identify risks, control gaps, and compliance impacts early in the delivery lifecycle to support effective mitigation.
* Contribute to data governance, metadata, and documentation standards where applicable.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify and implement process enhancements to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of product and platform services.
* Recommend changes to business analysis practices, delivery processes, and documentation standards to enhance quality and consistency.
* Stay current on industry best practices, regulatory updates, and developments in the data warehousing payments landscape to inform solution design and delivery.
* Monitor changes to business processes and systems to ensure downstream data and reporting impacts are identified

* This job works closely with Payments Business and Operations teams to elicit requirements, clarify process impacts, and validate business outcomes.
* This job collaborates with project managers to provide status updates, requirement insights, risk assessments, and delivery support.
* This job partners with developers, architects, and peer technology groups to translate requirements into effective technology solutions and ensure seamless implementation.
* This job interacts with Vendor Product SMEs to understand product capabilities, regulatory changes, and implementation considerations.
* This job supports Quality Engineering teams by providing subject matter expertise, reviewing testing artefacts, and helping resolve requirement gaps and defects.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Supports data warehouse (ODS) initiatives across Enterprise Payments Technology.
* Provides specialized business analysis expertise for data processed from the wire engine and wire room applications
* Acts as a primary liaison between Business, Operations, Quality Engineering, and Technology partners for assigned projects and enhancements.
* Contributes to delivery of regulatory and operational changes mandated by SWIFT and/or Payments Canada.
* Provides advisory and support services

jobs.description:
**FLEXCUBE Migration Consultant**

**Experience:** 5–15 Years  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

Levarus Solutions is looking for experienced FLEXCUBE Migration Consultants with strong hands-on experience in Core Banking data migration, system migration, and FLEXCUBE version migration projects.

We are seeking professionals who have practical experience in migrating legacy Core Banking Systems to FLEXCUBE and/or performing migration and upgrade activities across different FLEXCUBE versions, ranging from **11.8 to 14.x**.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in data migration, data mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and validation, along with good knowledge of FLEXCUBE modules and banking operations.

This is a dedicated migration role. Candidates with only production support, application maintenance, or general Oracle database migration experience without FLEXCUBE project exposure will not be considered.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in end-to-end FLEXCUBE Core Banking migration projects.
* Execute data migration activities from legacy Core Banking Systems to Oracle FLEXCUBE.
* Work on FLEXCUBE version-to-version migration and upgrade projects across versions 11.8 to 14.x.
* Analyze source system data and perform source-to-target data mapping based on FLEXCUBE data structures.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation processes.
* Prepare and execute SQL/PL-SQL scripts for data migration, data conversion, and reconciliation.
* Perform data cleansing, transformation, validation, and exception handling to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Work on migration of core banking data, including Customer/CIF, CASA, Accounts, Loans, Deposits, General Ledger, and transaction records.
* Conduct mock migration runs, migration rehearsals, and data validation exercises.
* Identify migration gaps, data inconsistencies, and technical issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Prepare migration plans, mapping documents, technical specifications, validation reports, and reconciliation reports.
* Coordinate with functional consultants, technical developers, database teams, and banking stakeholders throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, cutover planning, production deployment, and go-live activities.
* Ensure successful migration execution within project timelines and quality standards.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in FLEXCUBE migration projects.
* Overall IT/Core Banking experience of 5–15 years.
* Mandatory FLEXCUBE project experience.
* Experience working with FLEXCUBE versions ranging from 11.8 to 14.x.
* Strong proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Hands-on experience in data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), and data conversion.
* Expertise in source-to-target data mapping and migration strategy.
* Experience with Oracle database objects, packages, procedures, functions, and migration scripts.
* Knowledge of SQL\*Loader and data loading utilities.
* Experience in data reconciliation, data validation, and data integrity checks.
* Strong understanding of Core Banking modules such as:
* CASA (Current and Savings Accounts)
* Customer Information / CIF
* Branch Operations
* Teller Operations
* Loans and Lending
* Deposits and Term Deposits
* General Ledger (GL)
* Funds Transfer and Payments
* Understanding of migration testing, mock runs, cutover, and go-live activities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating legacy banking platforms to FLEXCUBE.
* Experience in FLEXCUBE version migration and upgrades.
* Exposure to multiple Core Banking migration projects.
* Knowledge of Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, or other ETL tools.
* Experience with Unix/Linux and Shell Scripting.
* Understanding of banking data models and FLEXCUBE database structures.
* Experience working with international banking clients and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

**Mandatory Eligibility Criteria**

* FLEXCUBE experience is mandatory.
* Candidates must have actual FLEXCUBE migration project experience.
* Experience in at least one complete or substantial migration project is preferred.
* Candidates must be able to explain the source banking system, target FLEXCUBE version, modules migrated, migration approach, and their individual contribution.
* Candidates with only general Oracle database migration or FLEXCUBE production support experience will not be considered.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for hands-on FLEXCUBE Migration Professionals who can independently manage migration deliverables, understand complex banking data structures, execute migration activities, and ensure accurate and seamless data transition.

The candidate should demonstrate strong technical expertise, banking domain knowledge, ownership of migration activities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, and client teams.

**Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resumes.**

Levarus Solutions is an IT consulting and technology services company specializing in Core Banking, ERP, CRM, Business Intelligence, AI/ML, and Digital Transformation solutions. **Job Summary**
---------------

This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and completeness of financial and operational records across accounts, products and transaction platforms. The role provides critical control over the end-to-end reconciliation lifecycle by identifying, investigating and resolving breaks, exceptions and discrepancies in a timely manner, thereby reducing financial, operational and regulatory risk.

The role supports the effective operation of reconciliation processes covering Nostro accounts, General Ledger and suspense accounts, trade and position records, card and retail banking transactions, and other operational control accounts. Working across multiple business functions, the role ensures that reconciliation outcomes are achieved within agreed service levels while maintaining adherence to reconciliation policies, control standards and governance requirements.

The role also contributes to process optimisation and change initiatives by supporting system enhancements, reconciliation platform implementations, business analysis activities and automation opportunities that strengthen operational efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Reconciliation Control & Exception Management**  
• Perform reconciliations across cash, Nostro, General Ledger, suspense, trade, position and retail transaction accounts to ensure books and records are complete and accurate.
  
• Investigate, analyse and resolve reconciliation breaks, exceptions and unmatched items within agreed timelines to minimise operational and financial risk.
  
• Escalate aged, material or high-risk exceptions through appropriate governance channels to enable timely resolution and management oversight.
  
• Maintain accurate reconciliation evidence, audit trails and supporting documentation to support operational control and regulatory requirements.
  
**Financial Control & Risk Management**  
• Apply reconciliation policies, operational procedures and control frameworks to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements.
  
• Identify emerging risks, recurring exceptions and control weaknesses, recommending actions that improve reconciliation effectiveness and reduce operational losses.
  
• Monitor reconciliation ageing, exception volumes and service levels, ensuring timely reporting of key control indicators and risk exposures.
  
• Support business continuity, operational resilience and risk mitigation activities, including testing and execution of contingency plans.
  
**Stakeholder Engagement & Service Delivery**  
• Collaborate with Operations, Product, Finance, Technology and country teams to resolve reconciliation issues and improve control outcomes.
  
• Manage internal and external stakeholder enquiries relating to account balances, exceptions, investigations and reconciliation status.
  
• Coordinate resolution activities across multiple teams and functions to ensure dependencies are managed and service commitments are achieved.
  
• Build effective working relationships that support issue resolution, control transparency and operational effectiveness.

**Reconciliation Systems & Change Implementation**  
**• Support business analysis and requirement gathering for reconciliation platform enhancements and transformation initiatives.**  
**• Translate operational requirements into business rules, configuration requirements and process improvements for reconciliation solutions such as TLM.**  
**• Participate in testing activities, including UAT, validation and implementation readiness assessments, ensuring changes deliver expected business outcomes.**  
**• Support production deployments, operational readiness activities and post-implementation stabilisation to minimise disruption to reconciliation processes.**  
**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**  
**• Identify opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate reconciliation activities to improve efficiency, scalability and control effectiveness.**  
**• Analyse exception trends and operational data to recommend sustainable process enhancements and preventative controls.**  
**• Maintain process documentation, operating procedures, escalation matrices and control records to ensure operational consistency.**  
**• Contribute to migration, change and transformation initiatives that strengthen reconciliation capabilities and service delivery performance.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Priority Skills**  
**• Account Reconciliation**  
**• Banking Operations Management**  
**• Project Management**  
**• Cash Management**  
**• Certification and Accreditation**  
**• Trade Management**

**Other Skills**  
**• Risk Management**  
**• Stakeholder Engagement**  
**• Strategy Development**  
**• Talent Development**  
**• Trade Reconciliation**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Energised by interacting with clients every day and creating positive experiences that build confidence in the Bank.**

**• Motivated by helping clients navigate their banking needs through clear communication, responsive service and practical support.**  
**• Enjoys building trust through consistent, professional interactions and being a reliable point of contact for clients.**  
**• Takes pride in representing the best of WRB by connecting clients to the right services, solutions and expertise across the Bank.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience operating within financial services environments where transaction accuracy, control effectiveness and risk mitigation are critical.**

**• Exposure to reconciliation processes supporting cash, securities, treasury, payments, cards, retail banking or financial markets products.**  
**• Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups, including Operations, Finance, Product and Technology functions.**  
**• Exposure to system implementations, operational change programmes or reconciliation platform enhancements involving testing and business readiness activities.**  
**• Experience navigating complex operational environments with high transaction volumes, regulatory requirements and service level commitments.**  
**• Business English**

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11)**
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Who We Are**
--------------

Within Citi’s **Analytics & Information Management (AIM)** group, you will do meaningful work from Day 1. Our collaborative, inclusive, and forward-looking culture empowers professionals to grow and make a tangible impact across one of the world’s leading financial institutions.

The **AIM Cards & Wealth** organization acts as the strategic intelligence engine across our credit card portfolios and wealth management franchises. We power customer acquisition, card spend stimulation, portfolio deepening, and wealth advisory insights. We actively integrate **modern data architectures, customer analytics, and Generative AI productivity frameworks** into our day-to-day operations to deliver hyper-relevant business insights, actionable customer intelligence, and optimized strategies for our cardholders and affluent wealth clients.

**What the Role Is**
--------------------

We are hiring a **Cards & Wealth Analytics & AI Enablement Specialist (C11)** to join our **Cards & Wealth Analytics, Insights & Optimization** team.

In this role, you will be the analytical owner and insight lead across Credit Card products (Acquisition, Spend Stimulation, Revolving, Balance Transfer, Loyalty/Rewards) and Wealth Management offerings (Investment Products, Wealth Advisory, Mortgages, FX, Time Deposits, and Digital Banking). You will combine **core data extraction, customer analytics, experimentation, and portfolio optimization** with **applied AI enablement**—leveraging modern GenAI tools, prompt and context engineering, knowledge base setup, retrieval optimization, Text-to-SQL assistants, and NLP to uncover high-impact growth opportunities, evaluate business performance, and accelerate analytical workflows.

As a C11-level specialist, you will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and data platforms, maintaining rigorous data governance while championing AI-assisted productivity and analytical optimization within the team.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **AI-Augmented Data Practitioner:** You actively leverage modern GenAI tools, conversational assistants, context engineering, and prompt design to supercharge analytics, code generation, and business insights.
* **Cards & Wealth Analytical Problem Solver:** You excel at translating complex business questions into high-performance queries using **SQL, PySpark, and Python**, analyzing spend patterns, portfolio balances, and customer lifecycle journeys to maximize business ROI.
* **Experimentation & Optimization Champion:** You apply structured analytical techniques—such as customer funnel diagnostics, test-versus-control lift analysis, and cohort evaluation—to uncover performance drivers across card products and wealth tiers.
* **Workflow Innovator:** You proactively automate repetitive processes—using AI for Text-to-SQL generation, automated insight summarization, knowledge base curation, and communication variant ideation.
* **Disciplined & Version-Controlled:** You manage analytical assets, queries, and automation scripts using **Git / GitHub** for robust code collaboration and version control.
* **Process & Controls Oriented:** You uphold strict data quality standards, customer privacy regulations, and risk/compliance controls across all analytical deliverables.

**What You Do (Core Responsibilities)**
---------------------------------------

**1. Data Extraction & Analytical Pipeline Management**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with Cards and Wealth Product Managers, Marketing, and Segment teams to translate business priorities and strategy objectives into robust technical logic.
* Develop, test, and execute data extraction queries and analytical pipelines using **SQL, PySpark, and Python** to generate high-quality analytical datasets and customer segment pools across big data environments.

**2. Cards & Wealth Analytics, Experimentation & Optimization**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* **Portfolio & Customer Funnel Analytics:** Analyze customer lifecycle funnels (Acquisition ➔ Activation ➔ Spend/Investment Engagement ➔ Balance/NNA Deepening ➔ Retention) across Card and Wealth portfolios to diagnose drop-offs and identify revenue-generating opportunities.
* **Experimentation & Lift Measurement:** Design and execute test-versus-control experimental frameworks and A/B test splits to isolate incremental product conversion, spend lift, revolving behavior, and Net New Assets (NNA).
* **Spend, Balance & Channel Optimization:** Analyze transactional patterns, merchant categories, revolving balances, and channel touchpoints (Mobile App, Online Banking, Direct, RM outreach) to recommend strategy refinements and targeting optimization.
* **Interactive Visualizations:** Build and maintain interactive performance tracking dashboards and diagnostic tools in **Tableau / Power BI** with automated underlying data aggregation feeds.

**3. GenAI Enablement, Context Engineering & Workflow Automation**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Context Engineering & Knowledge Base Setup:** Organize, structure, and curate internal analytics rules, data dictionaries, card/wealth product taxonomies, and strategy playbooks into searchable knowledge bases to enable high-accuracy AI retrieval and team knowledge sharing.
* **Retrieval Optimization:** Optimize data retrieval contexts and prompt structures to ensure conversational AI and retrieval-augmented tools deliver precise, hallucination-free analytical outputs and code.
* **Text-to-SQL & Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Apply Text-to-SQL interfaces and NLP techniques to accelerate ad-hoc data exploration, query generation, and unstructured client feedback/interaction analysis.
* **AI-Assisted Code Acceleration:** Utilize GenAI coding tools to rapidly draft, optimize, and debug complex SQL queries, PySpark data transformations, and Python scripts.
* **Automated Insights Summarization:** Leverage GenAI pipelines to generate executive narrative summaries, performance commentary, and anomaly explanations from card and wealth portfolio data.
* **Content & Message Variant Ideation:** Assist business partners by using Generative AI to generate personalized messaging copy variations, email subject lines, and client engagement talking points tailored to specific cards and wealth tiers.

**4. Code Collaboration, QA & Data Governance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Manage and version-control all analytical scripts, SQL queries, and configuration files using **Git / GitHub**.
* Perform thorough Quality Assurance (QA) validations—such as row count reconciliations, schema validations, null checks, and deduplication—before delivering datasets and insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of data definitions, analytical assumptions, and data lineage.

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role exists to lead the overall performance, governance and customer outcomes of the branch. The role is accountable for delivering sustainable business growth, maintaining a strong risk and control environment, and ensuring customers receive consistent, high-quality banking services.

Supporting the Bank’s strategy, the role drives customer acquisition, retention and relationship deepening by ensuring the branch delivers trusted financial guidance, exceptional service and access to wealth, liability and asset solutions that meet evolving customer needs. Through effective leadership of people, operations and change initiatives, the role strengthens branch competitiveness, customer loyalty and long-term franchise growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Business Growth, Profitability & Market Development**  
• Achieve branch revenue and business targets by executing branch plans that drive customer acquisition, customer retention, relationship deepening and sustainable portfolio growth.
  
• Strengthen branch profitability by improving the deposit mix across current and savings accounts, increasing non-funded income, managing fee waivers effectively and maintaining expenditure within approved budgets.
  
• Increase customer value and product penetration by leading the branch’s growth across current accounts, savings accounts, term deposits, wealth management solutions, and secured and unsecured asset products.
  
• Improve customer retention and lifetime value by monitoring customer behaviours, identifying attrition risks and directing timely engagement that strengthens long-term banking relationships.
  
• Grow branch market share and competitiveness by championing product launches, sales initiatives, customer acquisition campaigns and local promotional activities relevant to the branch catchment area.
  
• Improve productivity and commercial outcomes by monitoring revenue, portfolio, customer, cost and sales performance indicators and taking timely corrective action.

**Customer Experience & Relationship Leadership**  
• Build customer trust, satisfaction and loyalty by establishing clear service expectations and embedding customer-focused behaviours across the branch.
  
• Improve the consistency and quality of customer service by reviewing customer feedback and service measures, observing frontline delivery, role-modelling expected standards and coaching colleagues on improvement priorities.
  
• Protect customer confidence and the Bank’s reputation by ensuring complex complaints, service failures and escalations are resolved promptly, fairly and within appropriate authority levels.
  
• Strengthen customer relationships by ensuring branch teams understand customer needs and provide access to relevant banking, wealth and financing capabilities across the Bank.
  
• Deliver fair and appropriate customer outcomes by reinforcing responsible selling, customer protection and service standards throughout branch activities.

**Branch Operations & Service Delivery**  
• Maintain reliable and efficient branch service delivery by overseeing daily operations, transaction authorisation, payment release, operational workflows and customer service capacity within delegated authorities.
  
• Protect operational accuracy and service quality by monitoring work, reviewing exceptions and ensuring branch processes consistently meet established standards.
  
• Maintain effective control over branch funds, records and documentation by overseeing relevant account positions, transaction records, archives and document-retention requirements.
  
• Resolve operational and customer service issues effectively by providing subject-matter guidance, making decisions within delegated authority and escalating material concerns appropriately.
  
• Ensure branch resources support customer and business demand by managing staffing capacity, facilities, records, systems and other operational requirements.

**Change and Distribution Transformation**  
• Deliver successful branch change initiatives by leading the implementation of transaction migration, systems enhancements, process re-engineering, branch-space optimisation and premises reconfiguration.
  
• Improve branch productivity and customer access by aligning physical, digital and self-service channels with changing customer behaviours and service needs.
  
• Sustain business and customer outcomes through change by setting clear expectations, engaging colleagues, managing implementation risks and monitoring adoption across the branch.
  
• Strengthen branch readiness for future WRB priorities by identifying capability, process and resource changes required to support evolving distribution and customer strategies.

**Risk, Governance and Regulatory Leadership**  
• Maintain a strong and effective branch control environment by ensuring activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, delegated authorities and operational standards.
  
• Protect customers and the Bank from material risks by ensuring operational, financial crime, conduct, liquidity, market, reputational and other relevant branch risks are identified, monitored, mitigated and escalated.
  
• Strengthen branch governance and accountability by reviewing relevant management information, maintaining appropriate oversight and participating in applicable governance and risk forums.
  
• Ensure timely resolution of control weaknesses by addressing audit findings, compliance matters, operational incidents and recurring issues through appropriate corrective action.
  
• Promote responsible business conduct by setting clear expectations, reinforcing the Bank’s values and ensuring risk and conduct considerations inform branch decisions.

**People and Talent**  
• Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
  
• Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
  
• Lead by example by role-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.

**Job Purpose:**

The Manager, IT Business Analysis turns business needs into well-defined digital solutions across EDB’s priority programmes. Working with Business, IT and enterprise functions such as Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance and HR, the role leads business analysis from discovery to Go-Live with a product owner mindset: framing work around customer and business outcomes, crafting end-to-end digital journeys and prioritizing what delivers the most value. It works within EDB’s change-governance standards, reports against agreed metrics and raises risks, issues and blockers early. In line with EDB’s agentic-AI-based delivery model, it uses AI to produce requirements, workflows and indicative UI wireframes, and sets the standard for business analysis across the bank.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Business Analysis Responsibilities:**

* Lead business analysis on assigned programmes from discovery to Go-Live: elicit and analyze requirements through workshops and interviews, and produce BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Work iteratively with the business – draft early, review while gathering requirements, refine to sign-off – and stay engaged through design, build, SIT, UAT and Go-Live rather than handing over at sign-off.
* Map as-is and to-be processes; identify bottlenecks, control gaps and manual effort; and recommend simplification, automation and straight-through processing.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability from business objective to requirement, design, test case and defect; review vendor specifications and test coverage; and support SIT, UAT and business sign-off.
* Work across Business, IT and enterprise functions – Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Operations, HR and Audit – to align requirements and secure timely decisions and sign-offs

**Product Ownership Responsibilities:**

* Bring a product owner mindset to every initiative: frame it around the customer and business outcome, the problem it solves and how its value will be measured.
* Craft end-to-end digital journeys for customers, Relationship Managers and operations teams – mapping today’s pain points and designing target journeys that remove manual steps, handoffs and re-keying.
* Shape scope into MVPs and phased releases, write epics and user stories, and own and prioritise backlogs with business owners on value, risk, regulatory need and effort.
* Define journey success measures such as turnaround time, straight-through-processing rate and adoption, and track them after Go-Live.
