jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Influence & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with CTO, Group Technology, business and Australian leadership, and keep sponsors aligned on direction, progress and risk.

Leading People & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead a team of Principal Engineers, Staff and Software Engineers, setting clear mandates, accountabilities and decision rights, and creating leadership leverage rather than dependency.
* Partner with Chief and Distinguished Engineers, who hold the broadest technical authority for the portfolio, so that technical direction and delivery priorities stay aligned.

Driving Adoption & Change
  
  

* Champion responsible adoption of AI-powered engineering where it measurably improves quality, productivity and cost. Shape adoption approaches that scale, including domain-led, self-service onboarding, communities of practice, enablement and clear communications.

Governance, Risk & Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Ensure transformation outcomes are secure, resilient and compliant, partnering with cybersecurity, risk, architecture and platform teams.
* Embed engineering standards, guardrails and controls into the way teams work, in line with the CBA engineering practice and job architecture.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* This is an automation-first engineering role. Strong hands-on software engineering and automation experience is mandatory, with substantial experience in test automation.
* Demonstrated experience building modern automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD.
* Strong programming capability in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or equivalent.
* Experience across API, integration and end-to-end automation.
* Proven track record of leading enterprise-scale initiatives or strategic transformation programs, from strategy through to sustained adoption.
* Exceptional influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage and challenge senior executives and technical leaders.

**Qualifications**

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technical Lead(FIX Order)- Equities
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology
  
  
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores—often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview
  
  
The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team’s delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team’s technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team.
* Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes.
* Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team’s capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions.
* Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems.
* Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic.
* Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes.
* Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle.
* Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues.
* Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support.
* Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity.
* Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment.
* Develop applications and automation using Java or Python.
* Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans.
* Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team.
* Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention.
* Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems.
* Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers.
* Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity.
* Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions.
* Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects.
* Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior.
* Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python.
* Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions.
* Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools.
* Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics.
* Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

jobs.title: Head of Operations (Lounges)
jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.
  
  
We're looking for a Head of Operations to build and scale Revolut's global airport lounge network, from launching our first locations to managing a portfolio of lounges.
  
  
You'll own end-to-end lounge operations, ensuring each location delivers an exceptional customer experience while maximising commercial performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
We're looking for an entrepreneurial leader with expertise in airport lounges and building scalable operations across markets.
  
  
Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading end-to-end operational readiness and launch of new airport lounges globally, coordinating with airport partners, operators, construction, design, and internal teams
* Owning day-to-day operational performance across the lounge network, ensuring consistently high standards of service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency
* Maximising lounge profitability by driving revenue growth, optimising capacity utilisation, developing ancillary revenue opportunities, and managing operating costs
* Selecting, onboarding, and managing third-party lounge operators, establishing strict SLAs, performance targets, and governance mechanisms
* Defining and continuously improving premium hospitality standards across F&B, staffing, facilities, and customer experience
* Building scalable operating models, processes, reporting, and governance to support rapid expansion across multiple countries
* Ensuring compliance with relevant airport, safety, security, and local regulatory requirements
* Hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing operations team to support the growth of our global lounge network

**What You'll Need**

* Extensive experience in airport lounge operations, including successfully opening and operating lounges, ideally across multiple countries
* Experience managing multi-site airport lounge or premium hospitality operations, with direct accountability for operational performance and customer experience
* Commercial and financial acumen, paired with experience managing P&Ls, improving profitability, optimising capacity utilisation, and driving revenue growth
* An in-depth understanding of airport lounge operating models, including third-party operators, SLAs, airport requirements, hospitality standards, and F&B operations
* A track record of building operational processes, infrastructure, and teams from scratch and scaling them across multiple locations
* Solid stakeholder management skills, with experience working with airport authorities, operators, suppliers, and cross-functional teams
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to use data to drive operational improvements and ROI-based prioritisation
* An entrepreneurial mindset, capable of operating independently, and a willingness to be hands-on in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

jobs.description:
*Joining Capco means joining an organisation that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can and we believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.*
**About Capco**
Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.
  
  
**We Are**

* Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management
* Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Resilience etc.
* Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there
* Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit Financial Crime, Sanctions and Fraud transformation candidates across different senior levels into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance capability.
  
  
**Requirements**
Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives. This would range across:
  
  

* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients.
* Analysing our clients’ capabilities and finding opportunities to save costs and improve risk management through innovation within existing anti-financial crime and anti-fraud functions
* Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements.
* Supporting clients in dealing with operational backlogs (e.g. KYC files and alerts).
* Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud.

**Skills & Expertise**

* A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence.
* Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI
* Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD),
* Fraud (detection, prevention, response)
* Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes

This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* An understanding of the key market, global and regulatory drivers shaping the financial crime and the wider industry and an ability to articulate these by way of opportunities for consulting firms to support the industry.
* Proven expertise delivering change and lead transformation programmes
* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.

**Other Expectations**

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team.

**For senior level candidates**

* Mentor and coach other members of the team.
* Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones.
* People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth.
* Develop, drive and convert a pipeline of opportunities and lead on RFP responses.
* Fulfil a key role in account and proposition development within Market Domains and Key Client Accounts, assisting senior management to increase revenue.
* Formulate propositions and solutions that meet client requirements in addition to managing and directing pursuit activity.
* Strong bid management abilities, with a proven ability to mentor and train Consultants.
* Drive thought leadership and client campaigns
* Build and maintain strong client relationships within the sector, leveraging proven industry content and delivery capability.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A work culture focused on innovation and building lasting value for our clients and employees
* Ongoing learning opportunities to help you acquire new skills or deepen existing expertise
* A flat, non-hierarchical structure that will enable you to work with senior partners and directly with clients
* A diverse, inclusive, meritocratic culture
* Enhanced and competitive family friendly benefits, including maternity / adoption / shared parental leave and paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause and bereavement

* Own delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, quality assurance and capability development for ESG and sustainable-finance research, ensuring outputs are commercially relevant, evidence-based, consistent and suitable for senior internal and external audiences.

Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts (Client Servicing)

**Company:** Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Jayanagar 3rd Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Work Mode:** In-Office  
**Experience:** 3+ Years  
**Number of Openings:** 2  
**Industry:** Business & Strategic Consulting  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** As per company standards

About the Role

Floraison India Strategic Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and experienced Senior Executive – Finance & Accounts to join its Client Servicing vertical.

This is not a typical back-end accounting role. The selected candidate will work as a financial consultant for a portfolio of small to medium-sized corporate clients, including domestic and global businesses.

The role involves managing end-to-end financial activities for assigned clients, covering daily bookkeeping, monthly statutory compliances, payroll, financial reporting, book closure and annual finalisation.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting and taxation knowledge, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently manage multiple client engagements.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Handle daily bookkeeping and accounting of expenses on an accrual basis.
* Ensure all financial transactions are accurately recorded and categorised.
* Manage the complete accounts payable cycle, including vendor invoice verification and GST compliance on bills.
* Prepare and maintain weekly vendor registers and coordinate timely payments.
* Raise domestic and export invoices.
* Reconcile invoices and customer collections to ensure proper cash flow management.
* Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, including intercompany accounts and other balance sheet accounts.

2. Banking, Reconciliations & Cash Management

* Manage client bank accounts and cash flows.
* Prepare monthly fund request statements.
* Execute bank transfers and monitor daily liquidity.
* Perform monthly Bank Reconciliations (BRS) and foreign exchange reconciliations.
* Update and maintain fixed asset registers.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.
* Ensure all sub-ledgers are aligned with the General Ledger at weekly and monthly intervals.

3. Monthly Closing & Financial Reporting (MIS)

* Manage month-end closing activities.
* Record depreciation, prepayments and accrual provisions.
* Prepare and finalise monthly Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Statements.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports for assigned clients.
* Participate in monthly client calls.
* Present financial reports, budget variances and operational insights to client SPOCs.

4. Statutory Compliance & Taxation

**GST and Indirect Taxation**

* Handle GST computations and remittances.
* Manage Input Tax Credit (ITC) adjustments.
* Apply for GST refunds and manage GST return filings.

**Direct Taxation**

* Prepare monthly TDS statements and manage timely remittances.
* Handle quarterly advance tax planning, computations and payments.
* File e-TDS returns.
* Provide proactive tax-related guidance and tax-saving strategies.

**Year-End Finalisation & Audit**

* Manage annual books of accounts closure.
* Prepare Schedule III financial statements, including notes and accounting policies.
* Coordinate statutory audits.
* Provide required explanations and documentation to auditors.
* Resolve audit queries and ensure smooth audit sign-off.

5. Comprehensive Payroll & Labour Law Management

* Manage end-to-end payroll processing for assigned clients.
* Calculate salaries, employee benefits and reimbursements accurately.
* Handle monthly statutory remittances and filings related to:
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Shops & Establishments (S&E)
* Gratuity
* Professional Tax (PT)

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
Your profile
  
  

* 18+ years of experience in consulting and technology, including substantial leadership experience across Data, Analytics, AI and Cloud transformation.
* Prior senior leadership experience with a Big 4 consulting firm or leading Global System Integrator is mandatory, with evidence of building or scaling a Data & AI, Microsoft, Azure or Databricks practice.

Your role
  
  
Own the strategy, growth and operational leadership of the Microsoft and Databricks practice. Sponsor architecture and delivery reviews, resolve escalations, and ensure proposals translate into achievable scope, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.
* Build and lead a high-performing, multi-location team of practice leaders, architects, engineers, data scientists and governance specialists; drive hiring, certifications and succession planning.

- To prospect, identify, and on-board new to bank borrowing corporate relationships within Middle Market Segment in-line with Mashreq Bank’s growth strategy.
  
- Help the Business Segment in managing proposition for Middle Market including Business development, client acquisition, service quality, client survey, value proposition & analytics
  
- Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal & external campaigns and alignment with other Products & proposition including Risk policies, Payment & Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking and SMEs.
  
- Be an ambassador for Mashreq bank and develop the bank’s profile in the local business and wider community by originating and delivering Mashreq Bank products and services for corporate banking customers (annual revenue exceeding AED 250MM up to AED 1BN).
  
- Identify key contacts at potential client companies to establish and foster a relationship.
  
- Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
  
- To build a proprietary understanding of each client’s financial needs/issue agenda; originating and assisting in the execution of innovative deal solutions with and through sector and product partners.
  
- Fully dimension the client’s wallet and identify/create opportunities for Mashreq to deliver customized solutions.
  
- Structure the client’s requirement ensuring optimum Return on Risk Capital performance across business and credit cycles, while setting and meeting Mashreq’s revenue, cross-sell and capital management objectives.
  
- Owning the entire credit process from timely preparation of the credit proposal to obtaining the credit approvals and subsequent documentation and onboarding.
  
- Adhere to structures and processes in place for the management of credit, operational, reputation, financial crime and regulatory risk.
  
- Achieve business targets for new-to-bank, profitability, deposits growth, income growth and cross-selling.
  
- Ensure all relevant control measures are undertaken to minimize the risk exposure.
  
- Track and monitor deal flows, liaising such that vital business reports are prepared and available on a timely basis.
  
- Maintaining close contact with coverage, product and risk specialists within Mashreq Bank.
  
- Build a network of business introducers in the local professional and business community
  
- Help in development of client value proposition, innovative acquisition proposition tailored as per identified market / segmental needs.
  
- Help business manage in implementing new offerings via different tie up’s and strategic partnerships
  
- Support in set up of referral model with different partners inside/outside of bank and manage referral / intermediaries
  
- Work on creating the quarterly/annual strategy for the business on Proposition, tactical campaigns for sales force and for clients
  
- Coordinate with all business owners and product managers to create cross cross sell opportunities
  
- Support in formulating relevant policy / program guidelines to ensure proper controls are in place and work within the overall compliance policies
  
- Carry out competitor intelligence on regular basis and find opportunities of enhancement in existing proposition
  
- Work closely with the process and system development team to ensure the systems and processes are geared to cater to the ongoing business requirements, product parameters and evolving customer needs.
  
- To help ensure control requirements of the business are adhered to in line with bank policies to ensure good growth in a sustainable, profitable and predictable manner.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

- Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  
- University level education preferably in business, finance or related discipline
  
- Sound credit analytical skills and profound knowledge in various corporate banking products
  
- Strong networking, leadership and management skills
  
- Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  
- Strong working knowledge in MS office, web content and analytics
  
- Innovative – willing to develop a detailed understanding of client issues/needs and develop ideas/solutions in response
  
- Strong work ethic; high energy levels; results oriented – a self-starter prepared to take the initiative to identify and/or follow issues through, whilst exercising judgment as to when to seek assistance.
  
- Natural Team Player - Having an adaptable/flexible approach; willing to work in a co-operative manner to fulfill client and internal requirements

jobs.title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
jobs.description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice. Success will be measured on Visa's ability to provide proof points of growth in clients' businesses and being able to evidence the fact that we have supported our clients to define and implement strategies that will prepare them for future success.

Principal Responsibilities/Key Result Areas:

* Own and drive the Acquiring Advisory practice forward as its senior subject matter expert.
* Use this in-depth expertise to review, expand and grow the areas where Visa can support acquirers, processors and PayFacs to optimize and expand their business in a balanced manner that delivers clear results.
* Use Visa and external data to analyze client needs across the region's markets to identify opportunities for Acquiring Advisory consulting assignments with Visa's clients.
* In coordination with regional VCA teams, Country Managers, Products and Account Executives, ensure we operate as One Visa.
* Work in close partnership with Value-Added Services (VAS), and in particular Visa Acceptance Solutions, to shape joint propositions, embed acceptance solutions in consulting recommendations and generate pipeline for VAS products.
* Support the development of Acquiring Advisory project pitches and secure new consulting assignments with clients, as well as relevant re-engagement opportunities via a consultative sales approach in assigned markets under the guidance of the Hub lead and regional consulting leads.
* Deliver consulting projects. Resolve complex strategic problems. Synthesize and manage complex project structures when required. Manage, facilitate and implement consulting services and meet the client's business targets (assignment objectives, project scope, budget, paperwork, external consultants' supervision and project delivery). Ensure a seamless consulting experience for the client including all required areas/departments.
* Work on client site and/or virtually to design and project manage the implementation of recommendations as required.
* Ability and desire to mentor colleagues at all levels of the organization who are working to develop Acquiring expertise.
* Design, update and deliver the portfolio of Acquiring trainings for clients and internal Visa audiences, from executive briefings to in-depth technical and commercial programs, as an increasingly important part of the practice.
* Champion the use of AI across the Acquiring Advisory practice: embed AI tools into research, analysis, benchmarking and deliverable production, and ensure the team's AI fluency keeps pace with the fastest-moving tools available to consultants.
* Work closely with the global Acquiring practice and other global practices: share experience and project learnings in both directions, contribute to the set-up of standardized offerings, and leverage new global consulting solutions that will grow the practice.
* Take ownership of codifying best practices into reusable assets and of the ongoing build and maintenance of leading practices, new trends, business models and case studies to ensure that relevant information is always accessible and up to date.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Master's degree preferred.
* At least 10 years of overall experience, of which more than 5 years as a consultant in a top-tier management consulting firm with strong expertise in Banking and specifically in Acquiring — this consulting background is a core requirement of the role.
* Deep, first-hand expertise across all aspects of a payments acquiring business, including merchant solutions, processing, value proposition design, product development and launch.
* Experience gained within payment acquirers, processors, payment facilitators or card schemes is a strong plus. A combination of regional and global experience strongly desired.
* Strong facilitation and training delivery skills.
* Advanced consulting, client engagement, client contact and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and Visa.
* Full AI fluency and a genuine passion for AI: deep knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI concepts, capabilities and limitations, daily hands-on use of the leading AI tools, and the credibility to set and raise the AI standard for the team's research, analysis and deliverable production.
* Highly analytical with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Must have financial acumen and commercial awareness skills.
* Results-driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site and in a multicultural environment across CEMEA.
* Self-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary groups.
* Russian language is plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
